title: MHPSS Advisor
description:
Are you an experienced Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) professional with a passion for advancing evidence-based MHPSS practice in humanitarian settings? Danish Red Cross (DRC) is looking for a MHPSS Advisor to provide technical expertise, capacity development, and quality assurance to the Red Cross Red Crescent National Societies (RCRC) National Societies delivering community-based MHPSS interventions in humanitarian settings.

About the position and the assignments  

You will be based at the Danish Red Cross HQ in Copenhagen and will be part of the Health Team in the Technical Quality and Impact Unit of the International Department. The Health Team comprises technical advisors within health and mental health and psychosocial support. It ensures the availability of the necessary technical capacities to provide timely and relevant assistance and advice to DRC-supported operations, with a primary focus on the Africa, while also supporting MHPSS interventions in MENA, Europe and Asia regions as needed.

As a member of the Health Team, you will be working under the line management of the Health Team Lead and will also work closely with other colleagues at the DRC HQ and Regional and Country Offices (COs), as well as with NSs staff and volunteers. You will also collaborate with the colleagues from the International Federation of the Red Cross Red Crescent (IFRC) and the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC). The position does not have programme management responsibilities but supports programmes through technical accompaniment, mentoring, and quality assurance.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

  • Strategic planning and direction: Contribute to defining and rollout of DRC’s strategic directions within MHPSS in humanitarian settings. Support development and rollout of strategies, policies, and technical frameworks for MHPSS in humanitarian settings.
  • Technical support and guidance: Provide evidence-based guidance and advice to DRC COs and National Societies on MHPSS priorities, approaches and activities, remotely or through country visits and missions to ensure that MHPSS interventions follow industry standards and good practice. Support development or adaptation and rollout of relevant technical tools and guidelines to meet operational needs.
  • Strengthening of capacities: Support National Societies in assessing technical capacity needs, and in designing and implementing capacity-strengthening plans, including trainings, coaching, mentoring, and technical supervision. 
  • Program monitoring and evaluation:  Support planning and undertaking of assessments, baselines, endlines, reviews and evaluations, and monitoring of MHPSS interventions.
  • Advocacy: In close collaboration with relevant humanitarian diplomacy (HD) colleagues, contribute to DRC’s policy influencing, advocacy and HD efforts on MHPSS in humanitarian settings.
  • Resource mobilisation: Support proposal development by contributing to the design and quality assurance of MHPSS components in the project proposals that align with donor requirements and organisational goals and priorities.
  • Partnerships and collaboration: Foster thematic partnerships and joint MHPSS initiatives within the RCRC Movement and with external stakeholders. 
  • Surge deployments: Undertake MHPSS surge/deployments in support of DRC bi-lateral operations and wider RCRC Movement responses, including multilateral deployments with the ICRC and the IFRC.  

 

Your profile

We are looking for an experienced MHPSS professional with at least five years of experience working on community-based MNHPSS with humanitarian and development organisations, including at least three years in international postings in Africa and MENA regions. You hold a master's degree, or equivalent experience, in MHPSS, social sciences, or another relevant field. You have sound technical, strategy and advisory skills within community-based MHPSS in humanitarian settings and migration. You have proven experience developing and adapting technical guidance, tools and training materials, as well as designing and facilitating capacity-development initiatives for staff and volunteers of partner organisations. 

You have experience supporting assessments, technical reviews, evaluations, and the development of quality assurance processes for community-based MHPSS interventions. You are an excellent facilitator and communicator with strong interpersonal and cross-cultural skills. You work collaboratively, are well organised, and are able to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines. You are willing and able to undertake field missions, including emergency deployments, with travel of up to four months per year. Professional working proficiency in both English and French is required. Experience of working for the International RCRC Movement is considered an asset. 

We offer

A job with an opportunity to improve the lives of the most vulnerable people around the world. We further offer a unique opportunity to influence the strategic development and mainstreaming of MHPSS in humanitarian settings.

The position is a full-time position - 37 working hours per week. The position is 12 months with possibility for extension.

Salary and employment conditions are in accordance with Danish Red Cross’s collective bargaining agreement with HK and AC, depending on experience and qualifications. The position is based at the Danish Red Cross headquarters in Copenhagen and requires on-site presence. As this is a national position based in Denmark, the salary package does not include relocation assistance to Denmark and housing or family-related allowances.

Your future workplace

The International Red Cross and Red Crescent network is the largest humanitarian network in the world, with a presence and activities in almost every country. All Red Cross and Red Crescent activities have one central purpose: to help those who suffer, without discrimination, whether during conflict, in response to natural or man-made disasters, or due to conditions of chronic poverty. Our work is guided by seven fundamental principles: humanity, impartiality, independence, voluntary service, unity, and universality. 

DRC’s international department’s approx. 300 staff supporting RCRC NSs with planning and implementing humanitarian and development interventions in some of the most challenging contexts in 20 countries across Africa, MENA, Asia, and Europe.

We offer a meaningful work at a purpose-driven workplace with truly engaged colleagues. We focus on professional challenges, well-being and a flexible organising of your work life. All of us contribute to a great work environment and colleagueship. 

 

Application and further information

For any specific questions about the position, please contact us at zesd@rodekors.dk subject “MHPSS Advisor 2026”.

Interviews will take place in the second part of November with an expected start date as soon as possible and no later than 01 January 2027. 

We look forward to receiving your application and CV no later than 18 November 2026. Application and CV in English are accepted only through our online recruitment system. Applications made by email will not be reviewed.

title: Gram Equipment Graduate Program
description:
Unleash your potential in the Gram Equipment Graduate talent program - Experience hands-on learning in real business settings, open doors to global career opportunities, and join a community of change-makers!

About Us:

Gram Equipment is a global leader in providing innovative solutions for the ice cream and dairy industry. We are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology and driving forward the future of our industry. As part of our commitment to nurturing talent and fostering excellence, we are excited to announce our Graduate Program, designed to provide an immersive experience for aspiring professionals who are passionate about both mechanical engineering and commercial business.

Program Overview:

Our Graduate Program offers a unique opportunity for candidates with diverse backgrounds to gain a well-rounded experience in our organization. The program spans a duration of 24 months, divided into four rotations of six months each. This structure ensures that participants gain a comprehensive understanding of both mechanical engineering and commercial aspects of our business.

Qualifications:

We are seeking candidates who have or will graduate either in 2026 or in 2027, and who meet the following criteria:

  • Mechanical Engineering Background with Commercial Interest:

Candidates with a mechanical engineering background who possess a strong interest in commercial business and project management.

  • Commercial Engineering Background with Mechanical Engineering Interest:

Candidates with a commercial/business-oriented Engineering background who are keen to explore the world of mechanical engineering.

Key Program Highlights:

  • Mentorship: Participants will have the opportunity to work closely with a personal mentor from our global management team, offering valuable insights and guidance throughout the program.
  • Continuous Development: Gram Equipment is committed to fostering the growth and development of its talent. Participants will have access to the Gram Academy, a platform dedicated to ongoing learning and skill development.
  • International Rotation: Possibility for an international 6 month rotation in either our Turkish or US location.
  • Community Building: Join a vibrant and peer -based community of talented individuals within our organization, creating opportunities for networking, knowledge sharing, and collaboration.

How to Apply & Our Recruitment Process:

Our recruitment process is designed to identify and nurture potential talent. We believe in comprehensive evaluation, from video interviews and cognitive assessments to in-depth interviews and real-world business case evaluations during the Assessment Day, ensuring we welcome the best fit for our Graduate Program.

  1. Application and Assessment: Apply before 1st of March 2027, and if shortlisted, you'll complete a video interview and cognitive assessment.
  2. Interview and Evaluation: Promising candidates proceed to a comprehensive evaluation phase, which evaluates their behavioral competencies and business acumen, including a detailed assessment of a business case.
  3. Contract and Start Date: Upon impressing us at every stage, you'll sign a contract and officially begin your journey with the Gram Equipment Graduate Program on 1st of September 2027.

Join Us in Shaping the Future:

At Gram Equipment, we believe that innovation is driven by diverse perspectives and talents. Join our Graduate Program to embark on a journey that will equip you with the skills, knowledge, and experiences needed to excel in both the mechanical engineering and commercial aspects of our dynamic industry.

We look forward to welcoming the next generation of leaders to our team.

“For me, the biggest value being part of the Gram Equipment Graduate Program has been the people I have worked with along the way and the understanding I have gained of how the different parts of the organization come together.”Tommy Bui (ENG Integrated Design - SDU) - Project Manager at Gram Equipment

“The Graduate program gave me a strong network across the entire company and useful insights into many of our internal processes.” / “Contributing to such a significant change as a graduate was both empowering and a clear example of how my work could make a meaningful difference.”Luciana Apachitei (ENG in Global Business Engineering - VIA University College) - Engineering Excellence Project Manager "At Gram Equipment, I have shaped the company's direction and the projects related to it. I have had the chance to choose the projects that interested me. Many of the things I have learned in my studies, I have been able to apply to what I am doing at Gram Equipment, from engineering work to business understanding. I am actively involved in the strategy work, engineering practices and various digitalization tools. I use a lot of theoretical knowledge that I have acquired in my Engineering studies in relation to my daily work. My business background helped me understand how the business is working, and because the company foundation is at the technical aspect, my background has helped me identify its strengths and weaknesses very fast." -Rudy Mandrup Cazelles (ENG Product Development and Innovation - SDU) - Business Developer at Gram Equipment

Gram Equipment is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Et sabbatår i udlandet er for mange en livsforandrende oplevelse. Du får mulighed for at arbejde i et nyt land, møde mennesker fra hele verden, udvikle dig personligt og styrke dit CV med international erfaring. Men det, som de fleste ikke ved, er hvor tidligt processen faktisk bør starte.

Hvis du drømmer om at rejse ud i januar 2027, så er det allerede nu, du skal tage de første skridt. De bedste jobmuligheder, de mest stabile projekter og de mest attraktive destinationer bliver nemlig fyldt langt før afrejse. Samtidig tager det tid at finde det rette match, gennemføre interviews og få styr på alle praktiske detaljer.

Hvorfor starte processen nu – hvis du vil afsted i januar 2027?

1. Du får adgang til de bedste stillinger

Virksomhederne vi samarbejder med rekrutterer løbende, og mange stillinger bliver besat flere måneder før opstart. Starter du processen nu, øger du chancen for at få præcis den rolle og det land, du ønsker.

2. Du sikrer en glidende overgang efter studiet

Når du starter i god tid, kan du planlægge dit sabbatår uden tidspres. Du får ro til at afslutte dit studie, nyde efteråret og samtidig være klar til at rejse ud i januar — uden at skulle haste gennem interviews og praktiske forberedelser.

3. Vi kan matche dig med den helt rigtige virksomhed

Vi arbejder ikke med “første og bedste” løsning. Vi matcher dig med virksomheder, der passer til dine ønsker, dine styrker og dine mål for sabbatåret. Det kræver tid — og det er en klar fordel at starte før alle andre.

4. Du får fuld rådgivning hele vejen

Fra første samtale til du står på flyet, hjælper vi dig med:

  • Jobmuligheder

  • Kontrakt og løn

  • Bolig og økonomi

title: 1.assistent til SMP - Fyn
description:
Vi søger en erfaren 1.assistent til Fyn

Er du serviceminded og kan lide et job med meget kørsel?

SMP Rengøringsservice er i rivende udvikling og søger derfor en erfaren medarbejder på fuldtid (37t), til vores i forvejen stærke team på Fyn.

Som 1.assistent er dit ansvar at sikre afviklingen af den daglige rengøring i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

Andre opgaver kan også forekomme.

Du vil have direkte reference til din Serviceinspektør hos SMP rengøringsservice. Jobbet indebærer b.la. følgende arbejdsområder:

•   Skal stå for rengøring af egne pladser og øvrig bemanding iht. rengøringskalenderen

•   Skabe god relation til kunderne

•   Være behjælpelig med afløsning ved. ferie/sygdom

•   Hjælpe ved opstart af nye kunder og opgaver sammen med Serviceinspektør

•   Forefaldne opgaver i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

 

Det skal forventes, at timer kan ligge både tidlig morgen, eftermiddag og aften.

 

Hvem er du?

 

Vi søger dig, som trives i en omskiftelig hverdag, hvor opgaverne og dagene aldrig er ens.

Det er ikke vigtigt for dig, at du har faste rammer mandag-fredag fra 8-16, men tværtimod trives du med en flydende hverdag, hvor arbejdsugen kan variere med forskellige tidspunkter på dagen.

Som person kan du nikke genkendende til, at du:

•   Har erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

•   Trives i en til tider hektisk hverdag

•   Står til rådighed for rengøring af egne pladser

•   deler telefonvagt efter forudgående aftale

     står for sidemandsoplæring af rengøringspersonale

•   Kan håndtere og omgås forskellige kulturer

•   Behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale på et rimeligt niveau

•   Har kørekort

•   Kan fremvise straffeattest

Du får stillet en firmabil til rådighed, samt firmatelefon- iPad, og arbejdsbeklædning.

Vi glæder os meget til at lære dig at kende - så hvis du kan se dig selv i denne stilling, bedes du sende din ansøgning til: job@smpservice.dk  - husk at mærke ansøgningen ” 1.assistent Fyn”

 

Samtaler bliver holdt løbende.

 

Har du ikke hørt fra os inden den 04.11.2026, skal du betragte jobbet som besat til anden side.

 

SMP er en velrenommeret virksomhed i rengøringsbranchen, - og det vil vi gerne blive ved med at være

Vi beskæftiger i dag mere end 300 medarbejdere med kunder i en stor del af Danmark. Vi har landsdækkende og lokale aftaler inden for kontor, produktion, skoler, slagterier, bagerier, butikker, supermarkeder mv.

 

SMP har lokale afdelinger både på Fyn, Jylland og Sjælland

title: Senior Authorised Person (SAP) – Switching Leader
description:
Senior Authorised Person (SAP) – Electrical Operations / Switching Leader

Location: DenmarkEmployment type: Full-timeEmployer: Global Nordics

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Authorised Person (SAP) / Switching Leader (Koblingsleder) to support electrical operations on a major engineering project in Denmark.

The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating safe switching operations, electrical isolations and safety procedures across high-voltage (HV) and low-voltage (LV) electrical systems.

The position operates within an established electrical safety management structure, under the designated Operation Manager (Driftsansvarlig Person), and in accordance with applicable Danish electrical safety regulations and EN 50110-1.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate and oversee HV and LV switching operations.

  • Prepare and review switching schedules and electrical safety documentation.

  • Coordinate electrical isolations, earthing and safe access procedures.

  • Prepare, issue and cancel safety documents within the scope of assigned authorisation.

  • Coordinate with Control Engineers and electrical work teams during operational activities.

  • Ensure appropriate safety precautions are implemented before electrical work begins.

  • Supervise and coordinate personnel involved in electrical operational activities.

  • Support commissioning, energisation and electrical system handover.

  • Maintain accurate switching records, operational logs and safety documentation.

  • Participate in safety audits, risk assessments and toolbox talks.

  • Ensure compliance with site-specific electrical safety procedures and applicable Danish regulations.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Relevant qualification in electrical engineering or equivalent professional experience.

  • Extensive experience working with HV and LV electrical systems.

  • Previous experience as a Senior Authorised Person, Switching Leader, Control Engineer or equivalent.

  • Strong understanding of electrical switching, isolation, earthing and safe working procedures.

  • Knowledge of EN 50110-1 and electrical safety management systems.

  • Experience preparing switching schedules and electrical safety documentation.

  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate electrical work teams and operational activities.

  • Strong communication, organisational and safety leadership skills.

  • Good command of English.

Electrical Safety Requirements

The successful candidate will undergo a competence assessment and receive the necessary written operational appointment and authorisation under the project's Danish electrical safety management arrangements (KLS-D) before undertaking regulated electrical activities.

The role does not include statutory Operation Manager responsibilities or electrical installation work requiring separate company authorisation.

Application

Please submit your CV, relevant qualifications and details of your professional experience.

title: Head of the Nordic-Baltic Cyber Consortium (NBCC)
description:
About the positionThe Danish Resilience Agency (SAMSIK) is seeking a highly experienced and strategic leader to serve as Head of the Nordic-Baltic Cyber Consortium (NBCC).The NBCC is a Danish-hosted, EU-supported cybersecurity initiative established under the EU Cyber Solidarity Act. The consortium brings together Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Iceland, Latvia, Lithuania and Norway to build and operate a regional cyber hub that strengthens situational awareness and analytical capacity across the Nordic-Baltic region.As Head of the NBCC, you will be responsible for establishing and leading a new international organisation of strategic importance to both regional and European cybersecurity. While formally employed by the Danish Resilience Agency, you will report to the NBCC Executive Board, composed of senior representatives from the participating national cybersecurity authorities, and operate in close coordination with EU institutions.The position is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.Key responsibilitiesStrategic leadership and governance

  • Provide overall strategic direction and leadership of the NBCC in line with EU objectives, consortium agreements and national mandates.

  • Develop, implement and continuously adjust the NBCC’s strategic roadmap, including the phased build-up from initial deployment to full operational capability.

  • Ensure alignment between the NBCC activities, EU cybersecurity policies and the strategic interests of participating member states.

Management, organisation and budget

  • Act as head of the NBCC organisation, including direct line management of up to eight permanent staff based in Denmark and professional oversight of national analysts located in each participating member state.

  • Build and lead a cohesive multinational organisation with a shared operational culture, while managing differing national frameworks and practices.

  • Ensure sound financial management, reporting and documentation in accordance with EU and national requirements.

Operational responsibility

  • Hold overall responsibility for the NBCC’s operational delivery, including the secure and reliable operation of platforms for cyber threat intelligence sharing, analytical collaboration and communication.

  • Ensure structured and timely sharing of relevant cyber threat information and contribution to regional and European situational awareness.

About youTo succeed in this role, we expect that you:

  • Have proven experience leading multinational or international cooperation involving multiple stakeholders and governance layers; experience from Nordic-Baltic cooperation is a strong advantage.

  • Possess a strong understanding of cyber threat intelligence, incident response ecosystems and information-sharing mechanisms at national and international level.

  • Have demonstrated experience with EU cooperation, preferably including EU-funded projects and engagement with EU institutions.

  • Are able to operate confidently at senior political and administrative levels, nationally and internationally.

  • Can demonstrate strong regional insight and experience, for example from a Nordic or Baltic cybersecurity authority or a comparable organisation.

In addition, you:

  • Exercise strong strategic judgement and are able to balance political, operational and technical considerations.

  • Have excellent leadership and communication skills and are able to build trust across national and organisational boundaries.

  • Are fully proficient in English; knowledge of one or more Nordic or Baltic languages is an advantage. Danish language skills are not required.

About the Danish Resilience AgencyThe Danish Resilience Agency is under the authority of the Danish Ministry for Resilience and Preparedness. The agency is responsible for tasks related to cybersecurity, crisis management, physical security and protection of critical infrastructure.We advise and support authorities, companies and key societal functions in preventing and managing incidents and crises. The agency currently employs approximately 300 staff members working across disciplines in a highly engaged and mission-driven environment.About the NBCCThe NBCC is a Nordic-Baltic cybersecurity cooperation supported by the EU. Through the NBCC, the participating countries jointly establish and operate a regional cyber hub that enhances collective situational awareness and analytical capacity.The NBCC will jointly procure cybersecurity capabilities with the EU, employ analysts in Copenhagen and across the member states, and contribute to the European Cybersecurity Shield. The NBCC is organised as a distinct entity within the Danish Resilience Agency and is accountable to its Executive Board.As Head of the NBCC, you will be responsible for building this organisation from the ground up and for strengthening collective regional resilience against cyber threats.Salary and terms of employmentSalary and terms of employment will depend on qualifications and experience and will be determined in accordance with the collective agreements applicable to employees in the Danish state. The area of employment is the Danish Ministry for Resilience and Preparedness.Employment is conditional on obtaining and maintaining a Danish security clearance at SECRET (DK: HEMMELIGT) level for the duration of employment.The position is a fixed-term appointment for a period of 4 years, with the possibility of extension.The position is full-time 37-hours per week, and the duty station is Holsteinsgade 63, 2100 Copenhagen.To be eligible for employment EU/EEA Citizens are required to obtain an EU residence document as proof of your right to reside and work in Denmark. Non-EU/EEA Citizens must hold a valid residence and work permit before you can begin working in Denmark. Citizens of Sweden, Norway, Finland, or Iceland do not require a residence or work permit to live and work in Denmark. For more detailed information regarding the regulations for your specific citizenship, please visit: New to Denmark and/or Info Norden | Nordisk SamarbejdeIf the position is filled by an applicant not currently residing in Denmark, the Danish Resilience Agency is prepared to offer a relocation package of up to 45.000 DKK. Any other costs related to relocation or housing must be covered by the employee.Are you interested?Please submit your application via the “Apply” button on this page. Your application must be received by the recruitment system no later than 15th November 2026 and must include a CV and relevant diplomas of education.For further information about the position, please contact Kia Slæbæk Jensen at +45 2134 1851 or Morten Bro at +45 2178 4257.All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply regardless of personal background.Applications may be shared with participants from the employment committee from all participating countries.

title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project: The Department of Psychology at University of Southern Denmark (SDU) is looking for applicants for a PhD fellowship within the field of philosophy
description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project:

The Department of Psychology at University of Southern Denmark (SDU) is looking for applicants for a PhD fellowship within the field of philosophy, with background in one or more of the following areas: philosophy of psychiatry, philosophy of emotion, phenomenology.We are looking for a person with a relevant degree (M.A., MSc. etc.) in philosophy or a related field. Starting date is September 1st, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is fully funded, full-time, for three years. The PhD degree will be awarded by the Faculty of Health Sciences.

 

Research environment

The PhD student will be based in the research group of Applied and Interdisciplinary Phenomenology in the Department of Psychology, SDU, at the Odense campus. The research group develops, disseminates, and applies methods to support cutting-edge research into subjectivity and the nature of human experience. Current group members have backgrounds in philosophy, psychology, anthropology, neuroscience, environmental studies, and pain research.

The group directly supports the professional development of its members, most of whom are postdocs or PhD students. In addition to receiving support from the project team, the PhD student will be supported by the broader group to develop their research, presentation, and teaching skills, as well as other academic skills, including those required for organizing academic activities such as workshops and conferences and for successful grant-writing. The PhD student will therefore be provided with the requisite knowledge and skills for pursuing an academic career in Europe or abroad.

The PhD student will also be provided with a work computer and a dedicated workspace at the Department of Psychology.

 

Project description

The PhD student will be part of the project, Understanding Experiences of Mood Disturbances in Depression (DEPMOOD), led by Anthony Vincent Fernandez. The project is funded by Independent Research Fund Denmark and runs for four years, starting September 1st, 2026. The PhD student will join the project for the final three years, collaborating with the PI, a psychology postdoc, and several external partners in Europe and the US, including philosophers, clinical psychologists, and psychiatrists.

The aim of the project is to establish a taxonomy of the variety of mood disturbances experienced by people diagnosed with depression, providing more precise characterizations of symptoms than those currently offered by concepts such as “depressed mood” or “anhedonia”. The project combines philosophical and qualitative methods, and includes in-depth interviews with people diagnosed with depression. The PhD student will not be expected to carry out interviews, as these will be conducted by the postdoc and external project partners. The PhD student’s primary role will be to help analyze the interview data using a combination of qualitative and philosophical methods. Their PhD thesis will therefore be a theoretical contribution, but will build upon the project’s empirical dataset.

In addition to producing a thesis, the PhD student will be required to take a variety of short PhD courses, carry out an international research stay, and fulfil light teaching duties.

The PhD student will be provided with DKK 10,000 per year for travel. Additional funds may be available.

 

Qualifications

Before the start date of September 1st, 2027, the applicant should have a master’s degree in philosophy or a related field and total course credits equivalent to 300 ECTS. Typically, this is a total of at least five years of education combined between bachelor’s and master’s degrees, with 60 ECTS obtained for every full year of study.

The candidate should have a background in philosophy of psychiatry, philosophy of emotion, and/or phenomenology. Familiarity with qualitative research methods (especially analysis methods) is an advantage, but by no means required.

The candidate should be proficient in English. Proficiency in Danish or another Scandinavian language may be an advantage, but is not required.

For further information about the project, please contact:Anthony Vincent Fernandez

Department of Psychology

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

E-mail: afernandez@health.sdu.dk

Please note that while we are happy to provide answers to questions about the position and application process, direct feedback on application materials cannot be provided.

Applications must include (in English, or with a certified English translation):

 

  1. A letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.

  2. Detailed CV, including personal contact information as well as any publications or presentations

  3. Certified copy of diploma and transcripts (Master’s degree in a relevant field). If the applicant is in the process of completing their master’s degree, they should provide transcripts along with a letter from their supervisor confirming expected completion of their degree before September 1st, 2027.

  4. Writing sample of maximum 10,000 words (e.g., publication, conference paper, selection from a master’s thesis). If the sample exceeds this length, please indicate which section should be read.

  5. A document listing 2-3 references, with contact information and a brief note about your relation to the reference. Note that reference letters will only be requested for candidates invited to interview. 

At this stage, no project proposal is required. Candidates invited to interview will be asked to prepare a brief project plan.

Please do not use generative AI in the formulation of any application materials. The purpose of these materials is to gain a clear sense of you and your abilities.

Shortlisting and interviews may be used in the assessment process. 

For purposes of evaluation and assessment, application materials may be shared with external members of the project team at Aarhus University and Amsterdam University Medical Center.

Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated

 

Closing date January 15th, 2027 

We expect to conduct interviews within two months of the application closing date.Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students. 

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order)

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98   per year.

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.

As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. title: Software Application Developer - Home & Pro
description: We are looking for a software developer to join our Home & Pro product development team at Dirac at our office in Copenhagen, Danmark. If you are eager to work with cutting-edge audio technologies and contribute to innovative audio solutions, this role is for you. You will work on the Dirac Live end-user application that helps bring our latest flagship technologies to market, including Dirac Live Active Room Treatment (ART), now available on several leading OEMs.What Dirac Offers YouAt Dirac, we provide a highly entrepreneurial environment where you can be part of a team that is passionate about building a great business and inventing the future of sound. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work in leading-edge technologies that make a real impact on everyday experiences. You’ll be a part of a supportive and collaborative agile development team that values quality and continuous improvement. You’ll join a product area with strong momentum, with Dirac Live expanding across premium home audio categories, from AV receivers and processors to streaming amplifiers and soundbars.Key responsibilitiesAs a software developer for Dirac Live, you will join an agile product team of passionate developers and audio enthusiasts. You will contribute to the solution’s end-user application, including design, implementation, testing, and evaluation of the front-end. You will be key in integration, testing, and release. Most of the implementation is in C++ and the application is released for Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android. The team also releases plug-ins for digital audio workstations. This code is written in JUCE and is also part of your responsibilities.    Develop the Dirac Live application for desktop and mobile    Implement new features, as well as testing and maintenance of the existing applications    Implement the user interfaces using Qt QML and JUCE    Configure and evaluate the complete solution using audio equipment in our audio labs    Assist the product manager to refine complex and large work items into smaller, valuable and estimated user stories    Assist with 2nd-line customer supportWho you are    Master of Science in Computer Science, Engineering Physics or a related field    2+ years of industry experience of UI development    Experience building cross-platform applications for desktop and mobile    Programming experience and proficiency in C++    A team-oriented attitude, as well as the ability to work independently    Fluency in both spoken and written English    Valid work permit or citizenship that allows you to work in DenmarkDesired qualifications    Programming experience with Qt QML or similar languages    Strong passion for audio, and experience setting up audio systems for recording and mixing audio    Experience with relevant software engineering tools for CI/CD (Git, CMake, Conan)    Experience with agile development    Experience collaborating on UI/UX and product design    Familiarity with signal processingAbout DiracDirac is an audio tech company, known for best-in-class technology and a prestigious customer base that includes many of the world’s most reputable brands. We are passionate about audio and innovation, and our pioneering technology is shaping the future of sound experiences.We are a global company with headquarters in Uppsala, Sweden, and R&D facilities in Copenhagen, Denmark, and Bangalore, India, with representation in Greater China, Germany, Japan, Korea, and the United States.Please read more about us at https://www.dirac.com/ and follow us on social media!LocationThe location will be at Dirac’s R&D office in Copenhagen.

title: Marketing Koordinator til MyCruise (barselsvikariat)
description:
Er du struktureret, initiativrig og god til at holde mange bolde i luften? 

Brænder du for marketing, og trives du med at skabe overblik, koordinere kampagner og få mennesker til at arbejde godt sammen? 

Hos MyCruise søger vi en Marketing Koordinator til vores marketingteam på hovedkontoret i Vanløse. 

Stillingen er et 9-måneders barselsvikariat med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse. 

Som Marketing Koordinator får du en central rolle i at koordinere vores marketingaktiviteter på tværs af Danmark, Norge, Sverige og UK. 

Du bliver bindeleddet mellem vores kampagneansvarlige, lokale salgsteams og specialister inden for blandt andet paid media, sociale medier, nyhedsbreve, grafisk produktion og e-commerce. 

Din vigtigste opgave bliver at skabe struktur, sikre fremdrift og sørge for, at vores kampagner og marketingaktiviteter bliver gennemført til tiden og i høj kvalitet. 

Du bliver en del af et marketingteam med mange forskellige opgaver, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen, hjælper hinanden og har plads til både gode idéer og godt humør. 

Om jobbet 

Du får en varieret hverdag, hvor du er med til at sikre, at vores marketingkampagner hænger sammen på tværs af kanaler og markeder. 

Du kommer blandt andet til at: 

  • Koordinere marketingkampagner på tværs af teams, kanaler og samarbejdspartnere. 

  • Omsætte kampagnebriefs til konkrete opgaver og holde styr på deadlines, materialer og leverancer. 

  • Sikre tæt dialog mellem marketing og de lokale salgsteams om behov og kampagner. 

  • Koordinere versionering, oversættelser og lokal tilpasning af nyhedsbreve og øvrigt marketingmateriale. 

  • Assistere med tekstforfatning, korrektur, nyhedsbreve og lettere indholdsopgaver. 

  • Koordinere indhold og materialer til websites, sociale medier og annoncering. 

  • Hjælpe med dokumentation og afrapportering af partnerkampagner. 

  • Indsamle kampagneresultater og bidrage til evaluering og forbedring af kommende aktiviteter. 

  • Bidrage med idéer og praktisk hjælp til øvrige marketingaktiviteter efter behov. 

Du får selvstændigt ansvar for den daglige koordinering, men arbejder tæt sammen med vores kampagneansvarlige om prioriteringer, budgetter og timing. 

Du skal ikke kunne producere alt selv. Det vigtigste er, at du kan skabe overblik, følge op og sikre, at de rette mennesker har, hvad de skal bruge for at komme i mål. 

 

Vi forestiller os, at du: 

  • Har en god forståelse for marketing, er naturligt struktureret og trives med en hverdag, hvor der sker mange ting.  

  • Gerne har 2-3 års erfaring fra en koordinatorrolle i en marketingafdeling, et digitalt bureau, reklamebureau eller lignende. 

  • Har en relevant uddannelse inden for marketing, kommunikation eller tilsvarende. 

  • Har en god forståelse for digital marketing, herunder sociale medier, nyhedsbreve, annoncering og websites. 

  • Har erfaring med eller kendskab til projektstyringsværktøjer som Asana, Monday.com eller lignende. 

  • Har gode skriftlige kommunikationsevner og flair for kommercielt indhold. 

  • Er struktureret, detaljeorienteret og god til at følge op på opgaver og deadlines. 

  • Er proaktiv, har ben i næsen og tør stille spørgsmål og udfordre kolleger konstruktivt. 

  • Bevarer overblikket, også når tempoet er højt, og flere opgaver skal løses samtidig. 

Har du erfaring fra rejsebranchen, arbejdet med marketing på tværs af flere lande eller kendskab til Klaviyo, CMS eller Canva, er det en fordel - men ikke et krav. 

Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, tager initiativ og motiveres af at skabe struktur og gode resultater sammen med andre. 

Hvem er MyCruise? 

MyCruise er et af Skandinaviens førende specialiserede krydstogtsrejsebureauer. Vi samarbejder med en lang række af verdens største krydstogtsrederier og hjælper hvert år vores kunder med at finde den helt rigtige rejse. 

Vi sælger både klassiske ocean cruises, Exclusive cruises og River cruises. 

Vi har kontorer i Danmark, Norge, Sverige og Storbritannien, mens vores danske hovedkontor ligger i Vanløse. Her arbejder marketing tæt sammen med blandt andet salg, produkt og e-commerce om at inspirere vores kunder og skabe gode rejseoplevelser. 

Vi er i vækst og har store ambitioner for de kommende år. Derfor leder vi efter mennesker, der har lyst til at udvikle sig sammen med os. 

Hvad tilbyder vi? 

  • En spændende og alsidig marketingrolle med mulighed for at gøre en forskel. 

  • Tæt samarbejde med engagerede kolleger på tværs af vores fire markeder. 

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling. 

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med marketing i en branche, hvor vi sælger oplevelser og rejser. 

  • Personalepriser på rejser. 

  • Pension og sundhedsordning. 

  • Frokostordning, frugt, kaffe og sodavand. 

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og engagerede kolleger. 

  • En organisation med korte beslutningsveje og plads til nye idéer. 

  • Arbejdsplads på vores hovedkontor i Vanløse tæt på metro og S-tog. 

Lyder det som dig? 

Send dit CV og din ansøgning til job@mycruise.dk 

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat. 

Stillingen er et barselsvikariat på 9 måneder med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse. Vi ønsker opstart hurtigst muligt, og arbejdsstedet er vores hovedkontor i Vanløse.

title: Vil du være med til at skabe en grønnere fremtid og en mere bæredygtig vandsektor?
description:
Brænder du for at skabe innovative og fagligt holdbare løsninger uanset hvor komplekse udfordringer du står overfor. Så er WSP det helt rigtige sted til dig.De fleste opgaver vi arbejder med, handler om at skabe fremtidens løsninger og involverer fagligheder på tværs af hele organisationen. Din rolle bliver at bruge din faglige nysgerrighed og bringe den i spil på projekterne. Enten som projekterende, som projekteringsleder eller andet. Hos os tror vi på, at det aldrig er den rigtige løsning at bygge kasser, som du skal passe ind i, men at vi sammen bygger en platform du kan stå på.I WSP får du adgang til internationale eksperter og faglige netværk, hvor vi arbejder sammen på tværs af fagligheder og geografiske skel for at løse opgaverne bedst muligt til gavn for vores kunder og samfundet.  

Dit teamDu bliver en del af vores anlægsgruppe, hvis primære område er at indgå i projektering af mange forskellige projekter, hvor du får mulighed for at følge projekterne fra A-Z på tværs af hele forretningen. Vi er ca. 25 kollegaer i afdelingen, som er en del af et fagligt fællesskab på mere en 150 dygtige kollegaer med klimatilpasning og forsyning som overskrift.Du får derudover adgang til internationale faglige netværk, hvor vi arbejder sammen på tværs af fagligheder og geografiske skel for at løse opgaverne bedst muligt.Her kan du kan se mere om, hvad vi arbejder med inden for Transport og Infrastruktur 

Dine opgaverI WSP vil vi gerne give dig opgaver, der er med til at udvikle dig professionelt og personligt, men du er ikke alene om dem. Vi arbejder sammen og hjælper hinanden.

  • Detailprojektering af forsyningsprojekter (vand, regnvand og spildevand)

  • Planlægning og skitseprojektering af afløbs- og klimatilpasningsopgaver

  • Projektering af bassiner, pumpestationer og bygværker

  • Udarbejdelse af udbudsmateriale til entreprenører

  • Tilsyn og byggeledelse i anlægsfasen

  • Byggemodninger

Hvis du har erfaring med projektledelse er det også en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Dine færdigheder og kompetencerKompetenceudvikling bliver en naturlig del af hverdagen gennem sparring med kolleger og løbende erfaring fra projekter. Vi forestiller os, at du vil passe rigtig godt til jobbet, hvis du kan nikke genkendende til følgende:

  • Du har flere års relevant erfaring med projektering af anlægsprojekter

  • Du trives i åbent og humoristisk kontormiljø

  • Du kan arbejde selvstændigt med frihed under ansvar

  • Du er nysgerrig på kunders ønsker og forventninger

  • Du taler og skriver dansk

Hvad hvis du kunne arbejde i en verden fuld af muligheder?Med WSP får du en arbejdsplads med fokus på både professionel og personlig vækst. For vi ved, at arbejdet ikke er alt. Vi lægger stor vægt på, at der også er plads til familie, venner, fritidsinteresser – og til dig selv. Derfor tilbyder vi fleksibilitet i forhold til hjemmearbejde og arbejdstider, så du kan tilpasse dit arbejdsliv til dit liv. Work-life balanceVi går op i at understøtte individuelle behov, og vi accepterer og anerkender hinandens forskelligheder og styrker. Selvom vi går meget op i vores arbejde, ved vi også, at det ikke er alt. Det er vigtigt, at der er plads til andre aktiviteter og interesser og til familie, venner og til dig selv. Derfor er vi også fleksible i forhold til hjemmearbejde og arbejdstider.

Dit arbejdsliv har også en social dimension, og vi prioriterer et godt arbejdsmiljø. Derudover har vi også medarbejderforeninger der står for sociale arrangementer, en god kantine, massageordning, pensionsordning, sundhedsforsikring mv.

Det betyder meget for os, at du er glad, når du går på arbejde, og vi efterstræber en venlig og inkluderende kultur med respekt for hinanden, vi sætter pris på mangfoldighed og arbejder aktivt med ligestilling.

Sådan ansøger duSend os dit CV med en motiveret ansøgning og relevante dokumenter allerede i dag, da vi løbende afholder samtaler.

title: P-vagt i Vejle – deltid med weekendarbejde
description:

title: Studiekredsleder søges Hald Ege
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe oplevelser og fællesskab i Hald Ege?

I & U og LOF Midtjylland søger en engageret studiekredsleder, der har lyst til at stå i spidsen for en hyggelig og aktiv studiekreds for seniorer i Hald Ege.

Studiekredsen har 23 aktive deltagere, som mødes om gode oplevelser, spændende foredrag og ikke mindst det sociale samvær. Gruppen sætter pris på fællesskabet og glæder sig til at byde en ny studiekredsleder velkommen.

Din opgave bliver at:

  • Planlægge og koordinere studiekredsens møder og aktiviteter.

  • Inspirere til spændende foredrag, oplæg og gode samtaler.

  • Arrangere oplevelser og ture i lokalområdet, i byen og i naturen.

  • Være med til at skabe rammerne for et hyggeligt og inkluderende fællesskab, hvor alle føler sig velkomne.

Du behøver ikke selv at være ekspert eller stå for alle foredrag. En vigtig del af opgaven er at finde interessante oplægsholdere, gode udflugtsmål og aktiviteter, der kan give deltagerne nye oplevelser og inspiration. Måske har du også lyst til at inddrage deltagernes egne idéer og interesser i planlægningen.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du er initiativrig, har gode idéer og brænder for at samle mennesker om fælles oplevelser. Du er god til at skabe kontakt og har lyst til at engagere dig i en gruppe, hvor fællesskab, nysgerrighed og gode oplevelser er i centrum.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig! Kontakt I & U og LOF Midtjylland og hør mere om mulighederne for at blive en del af vores underviserteam. Send en mail til Job@lof-midtjylland.dk eller ring på telefon nr. 8726 2326

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig - kig ind på https://lof.dk/midtjylland/kurser/i-og-u/

title: 211-0367/26-2K Professor within Microbial interactions in plant and environmental systems
description:
Professor within Microbial interactions in plant and environmental systems Department of Plant and Environmental Sciences Faculty of Science University of Copenhagen The Department of Plant and Environmental Sciences (PLEN); Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen invites applications for a position as full Professor within the area of microbial interactions in plant and environmental systems. Research and teaching at PLEN covers topics within Agriculture, Plant Science, Biotechnology, Biosolutions and Environmental Sciences, dealing with a wide range of subjects focusing especially on plants, soil, and microorganisms from molecules through organisms to populations and anthropogenic ecosystems. It is our vision to maintain and develop our position as one of the leading departments for plant science and the related areas based on excellent basic and applied research. The department hosts state-of-the art infrastructure and unique field research facilities, with many opportunities for collaborations across the department. The department is organised into four sections, and the appointed professor will be affiliated to the section of Environmental Sciences located at the Frederiksberg campus. The section of Environmental Sciences carries out world-leading research across diverse disciplines, including soil microbiology, chemistry, agrohydrology, ecotoxicology, to assess and mitigate human impacts on ecosystems. By combining measurements, experiments, and modelling, the section supports both basic environmental science and applied solutions for sustainable agriculture, climate mitigation, and clean soil and water. The section of Environmental Sciences conducts world-leading research covering environmental biology, chemistry, and ecosystem science. Focusing on agroecosystems and impacts on soil, water, and the atmosphere, the section connects fundamental discoveries to solutions for targeting climate impacts, microbial diversity, and toxicological challenges. The professor is expected to teach both at the BSc and MSc levels primarily in the Biotechnology and the Natural resources and Environmental Sciences programmes at the Frederiksberg Campus and to expand these regular teaching commitments to the new MSc in Biosolutions in Kalundborg. Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department. Description of qualifications needed The professorship is advertised within the area of microbial solutions for climate-friendly and sustainable production systems. Full exploitation of these solutions requires basic understanding of the complex interactions in the environment which shape microbial communities and their functions in soil and at the plant root interface. Hence, the appointed professor should have a broad knowledge of microbial ecology including microbial functioning under soil conditions, drivers for microbiome assembly as well as microbe-microbe and plant-microbe interactions of importance for soil and plant health. It is expected that the professor has a recognized international position in the field and contributes to the design and implementation of new methodologies within microbial ecology. The successful candidate is expected to drive research within:
  • Model system development for causality and mechanistic understanding of microbial functioning under natural soil conditions
  • The microbial component of N and P nutrition in agricultural systems
  • Drivers for root colonization and microbial assembly in agricultural systems
  • Microbial functions of importance for soil health and functioning
  • Microbial solutions for climate mitigation and sustainable plant production
The appointed professor is expected to cover teaching in existing courses both at the MSc and BSc levels in subjects related to microbiology, molecular genetics and biotechnology. Likewise, the appointed professor is expected to be a driver for the development of courses to ensure high-quality teaching in a constantly changing educational landscape. Supervision of BSc and MSc projects is expected on a regular basis. International candidates are expected to be able to contribute actively to teaching in Danish within 3-6 years, including supervision and assessment of students. Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required. The candidate should fulfil the following criteria:
  • PhD or similar in molecular biology, microbiology, biochemistry, or a related field
  • Profound experience in the study of plant microbe-related issues in the context of sustainable agriculture
  • An excellent publication record that includes corresponding-author, senior author and first author publications of relevance to the position and demonstrate an impact on the scientific field of microbial interactions related to soils, plants and the environment
  • Proven leadership in an academic research environment and ability to guide an independent research group to achieve specific goals
  • Extensive experience in the development, organization, restructuring, and management of courses at BSc and MSc levels, supported by a comprehensive teaching portfolio that documents pedagogic competences and ongoing skills development.
  • Extensive experience with supervision of BSc, MSc, and PhD students, as well as postdocs
  • A teaching portfolio that documents teaching experience and reflections on teaching skills
  • Documented ability to obtain independent research grants from private and public foundations.
  • A strong track record of successful external/international collaborations.
  • Documented experience in organizational tasks such as departmental committees
  • Experience with outreach activities and communication of research to the public and stakeholders via, e.g., popular science events, press releases, interviews, conferences etc
  • Societal impact in terms of participation in appropriate stakeholder networks
Assessment of applicants will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered. General criteria apply to the appointment of professors at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement. Please read more here: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5c_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-professors.pdf Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here Salary and employment conditions The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff. Employment is as Professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish). The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background. Further information on the department is linked at http://www.science.ku.dk/english/about-the-faculty/organisation/. Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department Morten Petersen (morten.petersen@plen.ku.dk). Filing of application The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below. Please include
  • Curriculum vitae including information about external funding
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans
  • Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers
The deadline for applications is 8 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1. After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/. Interviews will be held on 18 March 2027. Please refer to the following no. in future communication in this case: 211-0367/26-2K.

title: Syerske eller systueleder søges til Friluft Service i Skovlunde

title: Viborg Stift søger en bygningskonsulent
description:
Viborg Stift søger en bygningskonsulent

Viborg Stift søger en bygningskonsulent med tiltrædelse pr. 1. januar 2027. Stilling er tidsbegrænset i 4 år og udløber den 31. december 2030.

Stillingen er en bibeskæftigelse.

Vi søger en bygningskonsulent, der forstår samspillet mellem kulturarv, arkitektur og de mange facetter, der er i folkekirkens bygningsmasse og som vil bidrage aktivt til disse bygningernes bevaring og udvikling.

Profil

For at komme i betragtning som bygningskonsulent skal du være uddannet arkitekt MAA eller have en tilsvarende godkendt eksamen.

Opgaver

Opgaverne indebærer råd og vejledning til menighedsråd, provstiudvalg og stift efter anmodning om bl.a.:

  • præsteembedernes tjenesteboliger og øvrige bygninger

  • ombygning og nedrivning af bygninger

  • opførelse af nye bygninger

  • køb, leje eller salg af bygninger og byggegrunde.

Du skal som bygningskonsulent efter anmodning afgive erklæringer i sager, der vedrørende ovenstående områder.

Du vil også skulle deltage ved vurdering af præsteboliger med henblik på fastsættelse af boligbidrag. Derudover skal du også deltage ved bygningssyn på stiftets administrationsbygning samt biskoppens embedsbolig.

Det er vigtigt at være opmærksom på, at du som bygningskonsulent ikke må påtage dig projekteringsopgaver for menighedsråd indenfor det stift du er ansat, med mindre stiftet undtagelsesvis godkender det.

Det praktiske

Som bygningskonsulent virker du, som rådgiver for de kirkelige myndigheder efter reglerne i:

  • Kirkeministeriets bekendtgørelse nr. 955 af 6. oktober 2009 om folkekirkens konsulenter

  • Kirkeministeriets cirkulære nr. 9779 af 6. oktober 2009 om fællesinstruks for folkekirkens konsulenter

  • Vejledning nr. 9789 af 6. oktober 2009 om folkekirkens konsulenter

Bemærk at bekendtgørelse og cirkulærer kan ændre sig både før og under ansættelsesperioden.

Honorar

Honoraret udgør pr. 1. januar 2026:

  • Rådgivningssager i henhold til § 8 i cirkulære nr. 9779 af 6. oktober 2009 om fællesinstruks for folkekirkens konsulenter: 1.236 kr. pr. time.

  • Erklæringssager i henhold til § 7, stk. 1, i cirkulære nr. 9779 af 6. oktober 2009 om fællesinstruks for folkekirkens konsulenter: 1.854 kr. pr. erklæring.

Honoraret tillægges feriegodtgørelse på 12,5%, mens der ikke skal tillægges moms.

Satserne reguleres årligt pr. 1. januar. 

Ansøgning

Ansøgning med bilag sendes til Viborg Stift på: kmvib@km.dk.

Ansøgningsfrist: mandag den 30. november 2026, kl. 12.00.

Der afholdes samtaler den 7. eller 9. december 2026.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du ringe til kontorchef Dorthe Pinnerup på tlf. nr. 23991197 eller souschef Katrine Søbo Andreasen på tlf. nr. 40572881.

title: Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing Department of Food Science Faculty of Science University of Copenhagen The Department of Food Science (FOOD), Faculty of Science (SCIENCE), University of Copenhagen (UCPH) invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor in Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. The research areas of FOOD have a shared mission to contribute to new pathways for society and industry to support the development of solutions based in biology to improve sustainable food production, food security and food safety. FOOD is recognized for excellence in food research, education and industrial collaboration. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. FOOD has the ambition to reinforce our teaching and research in designing and optimizing biology-based solutions as future sustainable food and ingredient technologies. UCPH is strengthening this area by offering the new MSc Biosolutions program in Kalundborg, Denmark, the largest bio-based manufacturing hub in Scandinavia, home to large fermentation-based manufacturers, and a vibrant innovation environment. The candidate for this position is expected to significantly contribute to this new Biosolutions initiative. The aim of the position is to explore the production and use of new solutions based on both biology and engineering addressing sustainability challenges inherent in food systems today. Although we welcome a diverse range of applicants, the focus of the position will be processing in relation to biochemically based solutions and could include the following disciplines:
  • Food process technology, ideally with an emphasis on fermentation & downstream processing
  • Food process system engineering
  • Use of sensor technologies such as in-line or at line spectroscopic tools
  • Large-data, modelling and prediction of food and ingredient processes.
  • Understanding of biological production systems and their use, and with an emphasis on downstream processing
A central part of the activities anchored to this position will be taking place in Campus Kalundborg, and it is crucial that the candidate is able to leverage the local ecosystem to foster strong collaboration with industry. Qualifications are expected in the following areas:
  • A collaborative and innovative mindset
  • Documented scientific impact and outreach in past research work
  • A proven track record in attracting external funding at both national and international level
  • Experience with international collaborations
  • Ability to establish industrial collaboration
  • Excellent interpersonal and communicative skills
Tenure-track assistant professor The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations regarding publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Ingredient Biochemical Processing. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties. The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact. Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered. Associate professor Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required. The candidate must be an inspiring teacher with a vision on teaching development, especially in connection with the new MSc Biosolutions program. A new campus with research and teaching facilities is currently being built in Kalundborg and the candidate is expected to contribute to setting up the facilities Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department. Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered. University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement. Please read more here For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf For associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdf Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here The tenure-track assistant programme The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures. Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields. After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen. Salary and employment conditions The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff. Employment is as either tenure track assistant professor or associate professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. title: Tenure Track assistant professor, associate professor or professor of Food Processing & Technology
description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor, Associate Professor or Full Professor of Food Processing & Technology Department of Food Science Faculty of Science University of Copenhagen The Department of Food Science, Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor, Associate Professor or Full Professor in Food Processing and Technology. Applicants must be capable of, and interested in, conducting and developing basic and applied interdisciplinary research of high international standard in the field of food processing and technology. The position will involve extensive collaborations within the department and with national and international academic groups and industrial partners. Research within the Department has a mission to unearth new solutions for society and industry to support sustainable food production, food security and safety as well as production of high-quality food promoting human health and wellbeing. The Department of Food Science is recognized for excellence in food research, education, and industrial collaborations. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. We encourage applications from a range of disciplines within the food science and technology area, ideally covering the understanding of food macromolecular interactions on a mechanistic level, how processing and formulation affect or determine these interactions, and how this influences final product quality with focus on functional properties. We are seeking a candidate who will establish an internationally leading research program, and we encourage a diverse range of applicants whose work may center on one or more of the following disciplines:
  • Developing a mechanistic understanding of interactions of food macromolecules in complex matrices during processing or formulation spanning dairy, plant, and single-cell protein sources.
  • How this knowledge can be used in the rational design of functional ingredients and healthy foods using established and emerging processing technologies
  • Development and utilization of high throughput methods for characterizing and quantifying the physicochemical behavior of food macromolecules in complex matrices.
  • Modelling and the use of machine learning/AI for simulation and prediction of the outcome of process unit operations on food and ingredient functionality.
  • Formulation and fluid dynamics of complex emulsions and the mechanisms governing this.
In addition, it is expected that this position will be involved in a significant amount of collaboration with industry, and therefore it is expected that the successful candidate has a documented successful track record in industry collaboration and working with innovation-oriented research. Furthermore, we expect that the successful candidate has a genuine interest in leadership and the wellbeing and development of their group. Tenure-track assistant professor The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations with regards to publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within the Tenure Track Assistant Professorship. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties. The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact. Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered. Associate professor and full professor Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required. In particular, the candidate must actively contribute with research-based teaching on the BSc in Food Science and Nutrition, and the MSc in Food Science and Technology programs, with an emphasis on the specialization in Dairy Science and Technology. Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department. Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship and full professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered. University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor / professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement. Please read more here: For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf For associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdf For professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5c_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-professors.pdf Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here The tenure-track assistant programme The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures. Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields. After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen. Salary and employment conditions The position is open from 1 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff. Employment is either as tenure track assistant professor, associate professor or professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish). This position comes with an opportunity to negotiate a start package that will help leverage the candidate’s scientific deliverables in the initial years of employment. The negotiation for the start package takes place as part of the recruitment process. Please read about the contents of the programme and conditions, as well as UCPH’s extensive support for international researchers, here Start package programme – University of Copenhagen . The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background. The successful candidate will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing. The section has extensive collaborations on research projects with major food industries in both Denmark and abroad. Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk).
