title: Administrativ kontorelev med interesse for drift og kørselsdisponering
description:
Bliv godt kørende med en elevuddannelse hos HB-Care! Som kontorelev hos HB-Care bliver du en vigtig del af det daglige arbejde i vores driftsteam, hvor vi hver dag arbejder for at levere kvalitet og god kundeservice. Du får en 2-årig elevuddannelse med speciale i administration, hvor du både kommer på skoleforløb og får masser af praktisk erfaring i virksomheden.

Undervejs bliver du introduceret til alle relevante områder, og du får også mulighed for at besøge vores andre afdelinger som fx bogholderi og udbud.

Vi tilbyder en alsidig uddannelse med praktisk erfaring, som giver dig et bredt kendskab til vores forskellige opgaver inden for driftsoptimering og administration.

Dine arbejdsopgaverHverdagen i vores driftsteam er præget af højt tempo. Vores vigtigste opgave er at supportere vores kunder – både borgere og institutioner – via mail og telefon.

Som elev vil du bl.a. arbejde med:

  • Indtastning og vedligeholdelse af stamdata
  • Oprettelse i kundesystemer
  • Administrative opgaver, der understøtter effektiv kørsel
  • Daglig support til drift og disponering
  • Håndtering af uforudsete hændelser i løbet af arbejdsdagen

Du får en spændende rolle, hvor du deltager aktivt i den daglige drift og gradvist får mere ansvar. Du refererer til regionschefen for Sjælland og Fyn.

Hvem er du?Vi søger dig, som har:

  • En naturlig interesse for processer
  • En struktureret og selvstændig tilgang til opgaver
  • Gode IT-kompetencer, især i Office-pakken
  • Øje for detaljer og lyst til at levere grundige resultater
  • Evne til at håndtere en varieret hverdag, hvor du kan blive afbrudt midt i en opgave
  • Gode samarbejdsevner og lyst til at hjælpe både kunder og kolleger

Uddannelseskrav:Du har bestået – eller forventer at bestå – en af følgende:

  • EUX Business (kontor)
  • HHX
  • HF, HTX eller STX samt 5 ugers EUS-forløb 

Er du over 25 år?Så skal du kontakte din lokale handelsskole for at få lavet en realkompetencevurdering (RKV), som skal vedhæftes din ansøgning.

OBS: Husk, at du ikke må oplyse dit CPR-nummer i din ansøgning eller dit CV.

Ansættelsesdato:Ønsket opstart mellem d. 1. januar og 1. marts 2027 – men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat. Samtaler afholdes løbende.

Hvem er vi?HB-Care er Danmarks førende leverandør af visiteret specialkørsel til kommuner og institutioner. Vi sørger hver dag for, at ældre borgere kommer til genoptræning, at skolebørn bliver kørt til undervisning, og at personer med særlige behov kommer sikkert frem til deres destinationer. Vores arbejde kræver både præcision, struktur og stor omtanke – og det er netop her, du kan blive en vigtig del af vores team.

title: Elektronik fremstilling og test
description:
Vil du være med til at fremstille avanceret måleudstyr, der anvendes til måling af vakuumtryk i højteknologiske produktionsprocesser?

Vi søger en engageret og detalje orienteret produktionsmedarbejder med erfaring inden for elektronikmontage, og som trives i et mindre team, hvor kvalitet og samarbejde er i fokus.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. være:

  • Montage af elektroniske og mekaniske komponenter

  • Loddearbejde (både SMT og through-hole)

  • Test og kalibrering af transducere

  • Kvalitetskontrol og dokumentation

Hos Sens4 bliver du en del af et mindre team, der samler, tester og konfigurerer tryk- og vakuumtransducere. Derudover vil du også indgå i opgaver omkring kvalitetskontrol ved varemodtagelse.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har erfaring med elektronikproduktion eller lignende teknisk arbejde

  • Er god til præcisionsarbejde og har et skarpt øje for detaljer

  • Har erfaring med lodning og arbejde med små komponenter

  • Arbejder struktureret og tager ansvar for kvaliteten af dit arbejde

  • Er en teamplayer, der trives i en mindre virksomhed med stor fleksibilitet

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra elektronikproduktion, men det er ikke et krav. Har du ikke tidligere erfaring, men er motiveret og har hænderne skruet rigtigt på, tilbyder vi grundig oplæring – især hvis du er komfortabel med at arbejde med små komponenter.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En alsidig hverdag med varierende opgaver, hvor vi hjælper hinanden

  • Et godt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø med en flad struktur og korte beslutningsveje

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling og indflydelse på dine opgaver

  • Fleksible arbejdstider og god balance mellem arbejde og fritid

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt fuldtid (37 timer/uge), men kan også tilpasses som deltidsstilling afhængig af din situation.

Tiltrædelse er hurtigst muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat.

Vi evaluerer ansøgninger og afholder samtaler løbende. Stillingen lukkes, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat, og kan derfor blive besat inden ansøgningsfristen.

title: Vi søger rengøringshelte på 35 timer til Børnehave Solsikken med ansættelse pr. 1. januar 2027
description:
Bliv en del af Team Rent Guld – vi hjemtager rengøringen i hele kommunen Team Rent Guld er Guldborgsund Kommunes samlede rengøringsenhed, som fra 1. januar 2027 får ansvaret for rengøringen på tværs af hele kommunen. Vi er i gang med at opbygge en professionel og velfungerende organisation, hvor kvalitet, stabil drift og godt samarbejde er i centrum.

Vi leder efter engagerede rengøringshelte, som vil være med til at skabe rene, sunde og indbydende rammer for kommunens borgere og medarbejdere. Den gyldne mission er at indeklimaet er en ren fornøjelse at befinde sig i.

Om Team Rent Guld Afdelingen bliver en stor og vigtig del af kommunens daglige drift og vil bestå af 2 afdelingsledere, 3 fagkoordinatorer, 3 flyvere og ca. 90 rengøringsassistenter. Sammen sikrer vi rene, sunde og indbydende rammer for både borgere, brugere og medarbejdere.

Hos os er rengøring en faglig opgave, der gør en reel forskel. Vi arbejder systematisk med kvalitet, moderne metoder og gode arbejdsgange – og vi prioriterer, at alle medarbejdere er godt klædt på til opgaven.

Samtidig lægger vi stor vægt på fællesskab og fleksibilitet. Vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af lokationer ved fravær, spidsbelastninger og hovedrengøring, og vi tror på, at en god arbejdsdag skabes gennem samarbejde, ansvar og en positiv tilgang.

Team Rent Guld er derfor ikke bare en arbejdsplads – det er et fællesskab, hvor du bliver en del af noget større og er med til at sætte standarden for fremtidens kommunale rengøring.

Om stillingen

· 1 medarbejdere på 35 timer ugentligt

· Mødetid kl. 05:00

· Mulighed for flere timer ved fravær, travlhed og hovedrengøring

· Mulighed for helligdagsarbejde

· Synlig rengøring af kommunale bygninger

· Sikring af et godt indeklima for brugere og borgere

· Samarbejde med kollegaer på tværs af lokationer

Arbejdssteder kan være

· Skoler

· Daginstitutioner

· Plejecentre

· Sportshaller

· Administrative bygninger

· Offentlige faciliteter

Hvem er du?

· En sprudlende personlighed, der ikke er bange for at tackle smuds, snavs og andre udfordringer med et smil - du synes rengøring er sjovt  

· Du kan jonglere med dine opgaver 

· Du er organiseret og pålidelig 

· Du har sans for humor og evne til at skabe et positivt og sjovt miljø omkring dig og din rengøringsopgave  

· Du skal have gode kommunikationsevner og øje for detaljen

· Du kan tale, læse og forstå dansk

Tidligere erfaring og uddannelse som rengøringsassistent eller rengøringsteknikker kan være en bonus, men ikke et krav. Vi træner gerne den rette person til at opnå skinnende resultater  

Vi tilbyder

· Et sjovt og dynamisk arbejdsmiljø fyldt med humor og kollegial støtte 

· Mulighed for at være med til at forme Rent Guld og din egen hverdag 

· Gode personlige- og faglige udviklingsmuligheder

· Du bliver klædt godt på til at løfte rengøringsopgaven og vi holder dig opdateret på de nyeste rengøringsmetoder og teknikker

Ansættelsesvilkår· Stillingerne er til besættelse senest den 1. januar 2027

· Efter gældende overenskomst med 3F 

· Kørekort (kategori B) er en fordel, men ikke et krav

· Ansættelse sker med forbehold for godkendt børne- og/eller straffeattest

Ansøgning Send din ansøgning ved at klikke på ”send ansøgning” og vedhæft din ansøgning, dit CV samt et billede senest den 15. november 2026. Vi tager kun imod elektroniske ansøgninger.

Samtaler afholdes i 25. november 2026 på Rådhuset. 

Mere information Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Michell Andresen, afdelingsleder for Rent Guld Syd på tlf. 25 18 06 52 eller på mail mdja@guldborgsund.dk

Mere om Guldborgsund Kommune Guldborgsund Kommune har pr. 1. august 2015 indført røgfri arbejdstid. Læs mere om Guldborgsund Kommune på www.guldborgsund.dk

Hvis du er klar til at blive en del af Rent Guld og tilføre ekstra glans til vores kommune, så send os din ansøgning i dag.

title: Viborg Stift søger en kirkegårdskonsulent
description:
Viborg Stift søger en kirkegårdskonsulent med tiltrædelse pr. 1. januar 2027. Stilling er tidsbegrænset i 4 år og udløber den 31. december 2030.

Stillingen er en bibeskæftigelse.

Landets kirkegårde er grønne rum, hvor kulturarv, natur og livshistorier mødes. Vi søger en kirkegårdskonsulent, der forstår dette samspil og vil bidrage aktivt til kirkegårdenes udvikling.

Profil

Vi forventer, at du er uddannet landskabsarkitekt fra Det Biovidenskabelige Fakultet for Fødevarer, Veterinærmedicin og Naturressourcer, Kunstakademiets Arkitektskole, Århus Arkitektskole eller have en tilsvarende godkendt uddannelse.

Opgaver

Opgaverne indebærer råd og vejledning til stift, provsti eller menighedsråd om folkekirkens kirkegårde og nære omgivelser, om bl.a.:

• anlæggelse og udvidelse af kirkegårde

• indretning af kirkegårde herunder driftsstyring, udviklings- og bevaringsplanlægning

• udvidelse eller udvendige ombygninger af bygninger på kirkegårde

• opførelse, udvidelse og udvendig ombygning eller salg af kirkegårdsnære bygninger til brug for kirken og kirkegården eller præsteembedet

• arbejdsmiljø for kirkegårdens ansatte

• kategorisering af kirkegårde

Som kirkegårdskonsulent skal du efter anmodning afgive erklæring i sager, der vedrører ovenstående.

Du skal også yde råd og vejledning til menighedsråd og kirkegårdsbestyrelser, som beder om det.

Kirkegårdskonsulenten deltager efter behov også i stiftets konsulentrunder, hvor vi bl.a. besøger kirkegårde i stiftet, hvor et menighedsråd har ønsker eller planer om et projekt. Ved konsulentrunderne drøftes projektet med menighedsrådet, og kirkegårdskonsulenten sætter sin faglighed i spil sammen med stiftets øvrige konsulenter. Der afholdes ca. 4 konsulentrunder pr. år.

Det praktiske

Som kirkegårdskonsulent virker du som rådgiver for de kirkelige myndigheder efter reglerne i:

  • Kirkeministeriets bekendtgørelse nr. 955 af 6. oktober 2009 om folkekirkens konsulenter

  • Kirkeministeriets cirkulære nr. 9779 af 6. oktober 2009 om fællesinstruks for folkekirkens konsulenter

  • Vejledning nr. 9789 af 6. oktober 2009 om folkekirkens konsulenter

Bemærk at bekendtgørelse og cirkulærer kan ændre sig både før og under ansættelsesperioden.

Det er vigtigt at være opmærksom på, at du som kirkegårdskonsulent ikke må påtage dig projekteringsopgaver for menighedsråd indenfor det stift du er ansat, medmindre stiftet undtagelsesvis godkender det.

Honorar

Honoraret udgør pr. 1. januar 2026:

• Rådgivningssager i henhold til § 8 i cirkulære nr. 9779 af 6. oktober 2009 om fællesinstruks for folkekirkens konsulenter: 1.236 kr. pr. time.

title: Executive Director, People & Organisation
description:
Would you like to shape the people, culture and organisational foundations of one of the world’s leading humanitarian organisations?  

This is an opportunity to bring your global leadership experience to a mission with profound human impact. As Executive Director for People & Organisation (P&O) at the Danish Refugee Council (DRC), you will inspire employees, empower leaders and turn strategy into meaningful change – ensuring that DRC has the people, capabilities, structures and safeguards required to deliver effective humanitarian responses wherever they are needed most.  

You will join DRC at an important time and have a real opportunity to influence its global direction and organisation. The global humanitarian system is going through fundamental change, and you will help shape and adapt organisational structure, operating models and staff capacity to the challenges and opportunities of the future. Your portfolio is global and spans organisation and culture, HR and leadership development, surge capacity, safety, legal affairs and Code of Conduct. As a member of the Executive Management Team, you will help shape strategy, and you will lead approximately 200 colleagues across P&O functions in headquarters and countries. About the job 

Reporting directly to the Secretary General, you will set the direction for DRC’s global People & Organisation strategy and ensure that it becomes an enabler for DRC’s ambitions. In close partnership with the Executive Management Team and senior leaders, you will create the conditions for talented people to grow and thrive – while strengthening an inclusive, and high-performing culture. 

This role calls for a leader who enjoys moving between strategic ambition and practical delivery. You will ensure that global policies, systems, data, employment conditions and governance provide relevant and timely support to operations. At the same time, you will carry executive accountability for safeguarding, ethical conduct, legal compliance, safety and DRC’s humanitarian surge capacity – areas fundamental to DRC’s mission. 

You will lead and develop an experienced senior team; Global HR, HR Denmark, HR Operations & Analytics, Surge Capacity, Safety, Code of Conduct, Legal, management support, and change, leadership and culture. Based at DRC’s headquarters in Copenhagen, you will work across a global organisation and build trusted relationships with colleagues and partners from many cultures and contexts. 

The impact you will make: 

  • Shape DRC’s strategy, culture and global P&O agenda. 

  • Lead organisational change, leadership development and employee engagement. 

  • Attract, develop and retain the people DRC needs to deliver its mission. 

  • Ensure effective global P&O policies, systems, services and people insights. 

  • Oversee safeguarding, Code of Conduct, safety, legal compliance, duty of care. 

  • Strengthen humanitarian surge capacity. 

About you 

You are a credible executive who is motivated by purpose and energised by complexity. You bring the strategic perspective to see the whole organisation, the judgement to make thoughtful choices and the drive to translate ambition into clear priorities and measurable results. Colleagues experience you as an inclusive and trusted leader with integrity and empathy providing the clarity to make decisions and create momentum.  

What you will bring: 

  • 10+ years of senior experience in global organisations and people leadership. 

  • A strong record of shaping people strategy and leading transformation across complex, international operations. 

  • Experience of organisational development, including the renewal and design of operating models. 

  • Broad understanding of governance, compliance, safeguarding, safety and legal matters.

  • Strong stakeholder management, analytical and communication skills. 

  • An inclusive, decisive and high-integrity leadership style. 

  • A relevant master’s degree and fluent English; additional competency in French, Spanish, Arabic and Danish are an advantage. 

All employees in DRC should master DRC's core competencies: Communicating, Taking the lead, Collaborating, Striving for excellence and Demonstrating integrity. 

We offer 

Contract length: Permanent 

Work location:  Lyngbyvej 100, 2100 Copenhagen Ø, just by Ryparken S-train station. DRC has recently moved to a newly renovated multi-tenant house (VOX) with a modern look and shared green canteen.  

Salary and conditions will be in accordance with the agreement between DRC and Lederaftalen between Dansk Arbejdsgiverforening and Lederne (agreement for managers), which can be found here: www.lederne.dk. This is a national position for which local terms and conditions apply.  

We welcome all nationalities to apply for the role. If you do not have the existing right to work in Denmark, DRC will support with applying and paying for a work permit. 

Application process 

If you are motivated by the opportunity to strengthen a global humanitarian organisation through its people, culture and organisational capabilities, we would welcome your application. Korn Ferry is assisting the Danish Refugee Council with the recruitment of the Executive Director, People & Organisation. Please submit your motivated application and CV through the designated recruitment channel. All applicants must upload a cover letter and an updated CV (no longer than four pages) in English. Applications sent by email will not be considered. 

Closing date for applications: Wednesday 11th November 2026   

Further information  

For questions regarding the vacancy please contact: Rabea Rehman, Associate | Executive Search at Korn Ferry, E: DRC_PO@KornFerry.com  

For more information about the Danish Refugee Council, please visit our website drc.ngo. 

Danish Refugee Council is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and positive work environment based on mutual respect for all employees. All applicants are considered for employment regardless of personal characteristics or attributes.

title: Medhjælper i bageriet - Priorparken
description:
Hos Lagkagehuset er vi lige så stolte af vores hverdagsglæde som af vores bagværk. Derfor leder vi efter en Medhjælper til bageriet, der kan hjælpe os med at holde produktionen godt kørende og skabe friskbagt brød, kager og bagværk til vores gæster hver dag. Her bruger du din lyst til at lære, dit gode drive og din glæde ved at arbejde sammen med andre, så vi sammen kan være et bedre bageri for alle.

Din hverdag bliver fyldt med…Kort sagt handler rollen om at understøtte produktionen og lære arbejdet i bageriet godt at kende.

Den lidt længere version er, at du bliver en del af et team, hvor du får oplæring i de forskellige opgaver i produktionen. Det kan være alt fra dejhåndtering, bagning og pakning til brug af maskiner og opsætning af frost. Hverdagen byder på mange forskellige opgaver, og vi roterer, så vi kan hjælpe hinanden. Du bliver en del af vores centralbageri, hvor bageri, pakkeri og logistik arbejder tæt sammen, og hvor vi hver dag skaber friskbagt kvalitet til vores gæster.

Vi tror derfor på, at du vil trives hos os, hvis du…

  • har lyst til at arbejde med bageri og trives med fysisk arbejde

  • har lyst til at lære nyt og udvikle dig i rollen

  • er en holdspiller og bidrager til den gode stemning

  • gerne har erfaring fra fødevareproduktion, men det er ikke et krav

  • kan tale, læse og forstå dansk eller engelsk

Hvad vi tilbyder digVi tilbyder en arbejdsplads med fokus på udvikling, samarbejde og fællesskab. Derudover får du rabat i alle vores butikker og adgang til Visma Logbuy, som tilsammen giver lidt ekstra forkælelse i hverdagen.

Din rolle hos osDin arbejdsuge er på 37 timer, hvor du arbejder med fast natarbejdstid mellem kl. 18.00 og 04.00 (arbejdstiden kan skifte) og fri hver anden weekend.

Vil du være en del af Lagkagefamilien? Søg jobbet her.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og kan lukke opslaget, når det rette match er fundet, så send gerne din ansøgning snart. Efter ansøgningsfristen hører du fra os senest inden for 14 dage. Ansøgninger modtages kun via vores ansøgningsportal.

Om stillingen

Som dagplejer arbejder du hjemme i trygge rammer, hvor kram og smil er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Du får muligheden for at gøre en forskel i de vigtigste år af børnenes liv. Her kan du skabe et inspirerende miljø, hvor læring og trivsel er i fokus.

Dine opgaver

  • Skabe tryghed og gode relationer til børn og forældre.
  • Planlægge din dag ud fra børnegruppens behov.
  • Arbejde pædagogisk med fokus på børnenes trivsel, læring og udvikling.
  • Deltage i legestue og arrangementer til glæde for børnene.
  • Samarbejde med tværfaglige partnere som talepædagoger og sundhedsplejen.

Vi tilbyder

  • Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling.
  • Udstyr til børnene til din rådighed.
  • Tæt samarbejde med dagplejepædagoger, dagplejeledere og sekretariat.
  • Indflydelse på din egen hverdag.
  • Kollegial sparring og mentorordning.
  • Legestuegruppe med kolleger fra lokalområdet.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har god intuition og kan skabe tryghed og gode relationer gennem omsorg og nærvær.
  • Brænder for pædagogisk arbejde med børn.
  • Indgå i et godt samarbejde med forældre, kolleger og dagplejepædagoger for at skabe den bedste hverdag for børnene.
  • Vil stille dit hjem til rådighed som et inspirerende læringsmiljø.
  • Deltager aktivt i dagplejens arrangementer og møder.

Du vil få støtte til at omsætte dagplejens læreplan, så du kan skabe de bedste rammer for børnenes udvikling. I det kommende år fokuserer vi på børneperspektiv, dannelse og fællesskaber.

title: PhD Position in Cheminformatics and Machine Learning
description:
SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a PhD position in cheminformatics and machine learning. 

The position will contribute to PFAROS, a flagship European research project dedicated to driving sustainable innovation and supporting the transition toward PFAS-free healthcare in Europe. Working at the intersection of chemistry, environmental science, artificial intelligence, and data science, the successful candidate will help advance next-generation approaches for chemical assessment by integrating diverse data streams, developing cutting-edge predictive models, and generating knowledge that supports safer and more sustainable chemical and material innovation. Through collaboration with leading international researchers and stakeholders, the position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to high-impact science addressing some of society’s most pressing environmental and health challenges.

The position will contribute to ongoing research projects and activities at SDU Life Cycle Engineering.

 

Main tasks

The main tasks include:

  • Collect, curate, and validate high-quality physicochemical, environmental, and hazard property data for chemicals in commerce. 

  • Evaluate and document the applicability domains and coverage of existing machine learning models used for predicting chemical properties. 

  • Develop, train, validate, and benchmark new models for chemical property prediction, including machine learning and generative AI-based approaches. 

  • Contribute to the integration of experimental data, computational methods, and machine learning workflows. 

  • Participate in collaborative research activities within the PFAROS consortium and interact with international project partners. 

  • Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, reports, and the development of new research proposals.

 

Qualifications

The successful candidate should have:

  • MSc degree (or equivalent) in chemistry, environmental science, chemical engineering, computer science, data science, bioinformatics, or a related field. 

  • Strong interest in machine learning, cheminformatics, data science, and chemical risk assessment. 

  • Experience with programming in Python and scientific computing. 

  • Familiarity with machine learning methods, data management, and statistical analysis. 

  • Experience with chemical databases, molecular descriptors, QSAR models, or cheminformatics tools is an advantage. 

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English. 

  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an international research environment.

 

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology. The research environment conducts interdisciplinary research on the global and systemic interactions between materials, technologies, energy, the environment and society.

The Department of Green Technology is located in Odense, the main campus of the University of Southern Denmark. Odense offers an international research environment and an open Scandinavian working culture.

 

Further Information

Further information about the scientific content of the position is available from:

Zhanyun WangDIAS ProfessorDepartment of Green TechnologySDU Life Cycle EngineeringUniversity of Southern DenmarkEmail:  zwa@igt.sdu.dk 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 12, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.313 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

The preferred start date is in January 2026. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

title: Bliv en del af holdet hos Le Petit Vinbar i Torvehallerne
description:
Bliv en del af holdet hos Le Petit Vinbar i Torvehallerne

Har du interesse for vin, sans for godt værtskab og lyst til at gøre en forskel? Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Hos Le Petit Vinbar søger vi en eller to ekstraordinære kolleger til et lille, men stærkt internationalt team af engagerede mennesker, der brænder for at skabe oplevelser som gæsterne husker – og vender tilbage til.

Vi tilbyder op til 120 timer om måneden til en person eller ca. 60 timer hver til to personer. Vagterne ligger mellem kl. 9 og 21, både på hverdage og i weekender.

Godt værtskab er kernen i det, vi laver

Vi søger dig, der tager initiativ, har blik for detaljerne og møder mennesker med varme og nysgerrighed. Du lægger mærke til, hvad gæsterne har brug for, og gør dig umage for, at alle føler sig set, velkomne og godt taget hånd om – også når der er travlt.

Du har erfaring fra café, bar eller restaurant og trives med at tage ansvar. Du behøver ikke være faglært tjener eller vinekspert, men du er interesseret i vin og har lyst til at lære og dele din viden med gæsterne. Interesse for mad er også et plus. Du kan kommunikere med vores gæster på dansk eller engelsk.

Vi er et lille hold, hvor alle tager del i hverdagens opgaver: vinservering, gæsteservice, madlavning, opfyldning og oprydning. Vi hjælper hinanden og lægger vægt på både godt samarbejde og omhu i det daglige arbejde.

Om Le Petit Vinbar

Le Petit Vinbar er en lille, livlig vin- og champagnebar midt i Torvehallerne i København. Baren blev grundlagt i 2013 af Ole Mejlby og Sylvain Codron, og vi importerer selv vores vine direkte fra små producenter i Frankrig, Italien og Østrig.

Hos os mødes vininteresse og personligt værtskab. Vi deler gerne historierne bag vinene og hjælper gæsterne med at finde noget, de bliver glade for – uanset om de kommer for et enkelt glas eller en hel eftermiddag.

Du bliver en del af et engageret team med mulighed for at lære mere om vin, mad og service og sætte dit præg på gæsternes oplevelse.

Praktisk information og ansøgning

Løn og tiltrædelse efter aftale.

Send en kort ansøgning og dit CV til job@lepetitvinbar.dk. Fortæl os gerne, hvorfor du har lyst til at arbejde hos os, om du søger ca. 60 eller op til 120 timer om måneden, og hvornår du kan starte.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette eller de rette kolleger. Send derfor gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Join the team at Le Petit Vinbar in Torvehallerne

Do you have an interest in wine, a flair for hospitality and a desire to make a difference? Then we’d love to hear from you.

At Le Petit Vinbar, we’re looking for one or two extraordinary colleagues to join our small but strong international team of dedicated people who are passionate about creating experiences that guests remember—and return for.

We offer up to 120 hours per month for one person, or approximately 60 hours each for two people. Shifts fall between 9 am and 9 pm, on both weekdays and weekends.

Hospitality is at the heart of everything we do

We’re looking for someone who takes initiative, pays attention to detail and approaches people with warmth and curiosity. You notice what guests need and take care to make everyone feel seen, welcome and well looked after—even when it’s busy.

You have experience working in a café, bar or restaurant and enjoy taking responsibility. You don’t need to be a formally trained waiter or a wine expert, but you have an interest in wine and are keen to learn and share your knowledge with guests. An interest in food is also a plus. You can communicate with our guests in Danish or English.

We’re a small team where everyone contributes to the daily tasks: serving wine, looking after guests, preparing food, restocking and keeping things clean and tidy. We help each other and value teamwork and care in our everyday work.

About Le Petit Vinbar

Le Petit Vinbar is a small, lively wine and champagne bar in the heart of Torvehallerne in Copenhagen. Founded in 2013 by Ole Mejlby and Sylvain Codron, we import our wines directly from small producers in France, Italy and Austria.

Here, a love of wine meets personal hospitality. We enjoy sharing the stories behind our wines and helping guests find something they’ll love—whether they’re stopping by for a single glass or spending the whole afternoon with us.

You’ll join a dedicated team, with opportunities to learn more about wine, food and service, and to make your mark on our guests’ experience.

Practical information and how to apply

Salary and start date by agreement.

Send a short application and your CV to job@lepetitvinbar.dk. Tell us why you’d like to work with us, whether you’re looking for approximately 60 or up to 120 hours per month, and when you can start.

We review applications and hold interviews on an ongoing basis, and will hire once we’ve found the right person or people. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Line operator for production in Horsens
description:
The job

We are looking for a reliable and experienced employee to join a production and slaughterhouse facility located in Horsens.

The position involves supervising and monitoring the slaughter and production line, ensuring that production runs efficiently and that quality standards are maintained throughout the process.

You will be involved in several stages of production, from the arrival of live stock to the point where the end product enters the cooling system.

Main Responsibilities

  • Receive and register deliveries of live animals.

  • Handle and verify documentation relating to weight, quantity and delivery information.

  • Communicate with veterinary inspectors upon arrival of live animals.

  • Monitor the slaughter line and ensure smooth daily operations.

  • Supervise the stunning equipment and make necessary adjustments.

  • Monitor and adjust scalding tanks and plucking machines to maintain optimal processing quality.

  • Record machine settings, adjustments and relevant production information.

  • Monitor the packing process and quality of the meat.

  • Identify and report production or quality issues.

  • Ensure compliance with hygiene, food safety and animal welfare procedures.

Your Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

  • Preferably has experience in poultry processing, slaughterhouse operations or food production.

  • Has technical understanding and is comfortable monitoring and adjusting production equipment.

  • Is quality-conscious, responsible and able to work independently.

  • Is comfortable working in a slaughterhouse environment and handling live animals.

  • Is flexible regarding working hours and overtime.

  • Can communicate effectively with colleagues and relevant personnel.

Working hours and conditions

  • Primarily a 4-day working week (Monday – Thursday)

  • Every 7th and 8th week, the schedule includes 5 working days (Monday – Friday)

  • Start time 06:30 AM. Working hours depend on production and continue until the slaughter line has finished operating. Long working days and overtime must be expected. Some shifts may continue until approximately 18:00 or later.

Salary and benefits

  • Salary based on qualifications and relevant experience.

  • Pension according to the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

  • Additional flexible benefits (fritvalg) according to the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

  • Employment conditions in accordance with the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

Interested?

Are you experienced in slaughterhouse production or production in general and looking for a new opportunity in Horsens?

We would like to hear from you.

Apply today by uploading your CV and a short description of your relevant experience.

title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

title: Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing Department of Food Science Faculty of Science University of Copenhagen The Department of Food Science (FOOD), Faculty of Science (SCIENCE), University of Copenhagen (UCPH) invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor in Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. The research areas of FOOD have a shared mission to contribute to new pathways for society and industry to support the development of solutions based in biology to improve sustainable food production, food security and food safety. FOOD is recognized for excellence in food research, education and industrial collaboration. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. FOOD has the ambition to reinforce our teaching and research in designing and optimizing biology-based solutions as future sustainable food and ingredient technologies. UCPH is strengthening this area by offering the new MSc Biosolutions program in Kalundborg, Denmark, the largest bio-based manufacturing hub in Scandinavia, home to large fermentation-based manufacturers, and a vibrant innovation environment. The candidate for this position is expected to significantly contribute to this new Biosolutions initiative. The aim of the position is to explore the production and use of new solutions based on both biology and engineering addressing sustainability challenges inherent in food systems today. Although we welcome a diverse range of applicants, the focus of the position will be processing in relation to biochemically based solutions and could include the following disciplines:
  • Food process technology, ideally with an emphasis on fermentation & downstream processing
  • Food process system engineering
  • Use of sensor technologies such as in-line or at line spectroscopic tools
  • Large-data, modelling and prediction of food and ingredient processes.
  • Understanding of biological production systems and their use, and with an emphasis on downstream processing
A central part of the activities anchored to this position will be taking place in Campus Kalundborg, and it is crucial that the candidate is able to leverage the local ecosystem to foster strong collaboration with industry. Qualifications are expected in the following areas:
  • A collaborative and innovative mindset
  • Documented scientific impact and outreach in past research work
  • A proven track record in attracting external funding at both national and international level
  • Experience with international collaborations
  • Ability to establish industrial collaboration
  • Excellent interpersonal and communicative skills
Tenure-track assistant professor The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations regarding publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Ingredient Biochemical Processing. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties. The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact. Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered. Associate professor Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required. The candidate must be an inspiring teacher with a vision on teaching development, especially in connection with the new MSc Biosolutions program. A new campus with research and teaching facilities is currently being built in Kalundborg and the candidate is expected to contribute to setting up the facilities Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department. Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered. University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement. Please read more here For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf For associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdf Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here The tenure-track assistant programme The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures. Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields. After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen. Salary and employment conditions The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff. Employment is as either tenure track assistant professor or associate professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish). The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background. The Professor will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing. Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk). Filing of application The position may be applied for at the tenure-track assistant professor level or associate professor level. Please note that it is possible to apply at more than one level. If applied at more than one level, separate applications must be submitted (see below). The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below. Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include
  • Curriculum vitae including:
    • Please describe and document international network and relations
    • Please describe and document internationally based activities
    • Positions held at universities/research institutions outside Denmark
    • Outreach activities, i.e. popular lectures or other activities in the media
    • Grants held, personal or in part. Career development grants.
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan - description of current and future research plans
  • If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document:
    • Experience with supervision of BSc and MSc students
    • Teaching experience
    • Formal pedagogical training
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers
Applying for the associate professorship please include
  • Curriculum vitae including information about external funding
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans
  • Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers
The deadline for applications is 3 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1. After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/. Interviews will be held on 8 March 2027. Please refer to the following no. in future communication in this case: 211-0263/26-2N, Tenure-track Assistant Professor Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. 211-0760/26-2E, Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing.

Applicants must be capable of, and interested in, conducting and developing basic and applied interdisciplinary research of high international standard in the field of food processing and technology. The position will involve extensive collaborations within the department and with national and international academic groups and industrial partners. title: Executive Director, People & Organisation
description:
Would you like to shape the people, culture and organisational foundations of one of the world’s leading humanitarian organisations?  

This is an opportunity to bring your global leadership experience to a mission with profound human impact. As Executive Director for People & Organisation (P&O) at the Danish Refugee Council (DRC), you will inspire employees, empower leaders and turn strategy into meaningful change – ensuring that DRC has the people, capabilities, structures and safeguards required to deliver effective humanitarian responses wherever they are needed most.  

You will join DRC at an important time and have a real opportunity to influence its global direction and organisation. The global humanitarian system is going through fundamental change, and you will help shape and adapt organisational structure, operating models and staff capacity to the challenges and opportunities of the future. Your portfolio is global and spans organisation and culture, HR and leadership development, surge capacity, safety, legal affairs and Code of Conduct. As a member of the Executive Management Team, you will help shape strategy, and you will lead approximately 200 colleagues across P&O functions in headquarters and countries. About the job 

Reporting directly to the Secretary General, you will set the direction for DRC’s global People & Organisation strategy and ensure that it becomes an enabler for DRC’s ambitions. In close partnership with the Executive Management Team and senior leaders, you will create the conditions for talented people to grow and thrive – while strengthening an inclusive, and high-performing culture. 

This role calls for a leader who enjoys moving between strategic ambition and practical delivery. You will ensure that global policies, systems, data, employment conditions and governance provide relevant and timely support to operations. At the same time, you will carry executive accountability for safeguarding, ethical conduct, legal compliance, safety and DRC’s humanitarian surge capacity – areas fundamental to DRC’s mission. 

You will lead and develop an experienced senior team; Global HR, HR Denmark, HR Operations & Analytics, Surge Capacity, Safety, Code of Conduct, Legal, management support, and change, leadership and culture. Based at DRC’s headquarters in Copenhagen, you will work across a global organisation and build trusted relationships with colleagues and partners from many cultures and contexts. 

The impact you will make: 

  • Shape DRC’s strategy, culture and global P&O agenda. 

  • Lead organisational change, leadership development and employee engagement. 

  • Attract, develop and retain the people DRC needs to deliver its mission. 

  • Ensure effective global P&O policies, systems, services and people insights. 

  • Oversee safeguarding, Code of Conduct, safety, legal compliance, duty of care. 

  • Strengthen humanitarian surge capacity. 

About you 

You are a credible executive who is motivated by purpose and energised by complexity. You bring the strategic perspective to see the whole organisation, the judgement to make thoughtful choices and the drive to translate ambition into clear priorities and measurable results. Colleagues experience you as an inclusive and trusted leader with integrity and empathy providing the clarity to make decisions and create momentum.  

What you will bring: 

  • 10+ years of senior experience in global organisations and people leadership. 

  • A strong record of shaping people strategy and leading transformation across complex, international operations. 

  • Experience of organisational development, including the renewal and design of operating models. 

  • Broad understanding of governance, compliance, safeguarding, safety and legal matters.

  • Strong stakeholder management, analytical and communication skills. 

  • An inclusive, decisive and high-integrity leadership style. 

  • A relevant master’s degree and fluent English; additional competency in French, Spanish, Arabic and Danish are an advantage. 

All employees in DRC should master DRC's core competencies: Communicating, Taking the lead, Collaborating, Striving for excellence and Demonstrating integrity. 

We offer 

Contract length: Permanent 

Work location:  Lyngbyvej 100, 2100 Copenhagen Ø, just by Ryparken S-train station. DRC has recently moved to a newly renovated multi-tenant house (VOX) with a modern look and shared green canteen.  

Salary and conditions will be in accordance with the agreement between DRC and Lederaftalen between Dansk Arbejdsgiverforening and Lederne (agreement for managers), which can be found here: www.lederne.dk. This is a national position for which local terms and conditions apply.  

We welcome all nationalities to apply for the role. If you do not have the existing right to work in Denmark, DRC will support with applying and paying for a work permit. 

Application process 

If you are motivated by the opportunity to strengthen a global humanitarian organisation through its people, culture and organisational capabilities, we would welcome your application. Korn Ferry is assisting the Danish Refugee Council with the recruitment of the Executive Director, People & Organisation. Please submit your motivated application and CV through the designated recruitment channel. All applicants must upload a cover letter and an updated CV (no longer than four pages) in English. Applications sent by email will not be considered.

Further information  

For questions regarding the vacancy please contact: Rabea Rehman, Associate | Executive Search at Korn Ferry, E: DRC_PO@KornFerry.com  

For more information about the Danish Refugee Council, please visit our website drc.ngo. 

Danish Refugee Council is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and positive work environment based on mutual respect for all employees. All applicants are considered for employment regardless of personal characteristics or attributes.

title: PhD Position in Cheminformatics and Machine Learning
description:
SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a PhD position in cheminformatics and machine learning. 

The position will contribute to PFAROS, a flagship European research project dedicated to driving sustainable innovation and supporting the transition toward PFAS-free healthcare in Europe. Working at the intersection of chemistry, environmental science, artificial intelligence, and data science, the successful candidate will help advance next-generation approaches for chemical assessment by integrating diverse data streams, developing cutting-edge predictive models, and generating knowledge that supports safer and more sustainable chemical and material innovation. Through collaboration with leading international researchers and stakeholders, the position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to high-impact science addressing some of society’s most pressing environmental and health challenges.

The position will contribute to ongoing research projects and activities at SDU Life Cycle Engineering.

 

Main tasks

The main tasks include:

  • Collect, curate, and validate high-quality physicochemical, environmental, and hazard property data for chemicals in commerce. 

  • Evaluate and document the applicability domains and coverage of existing machine learning models used for predicting chemical properties. 

  • Develop, train, validate, and benchmark new models for chemical property prediction, including machine learning and generative AI-based approaches. 

  • Contribute to the integration of experimental data, computational methods, and machine learning workflows. 

  • Participate in collaborative research activities within the PFAROS consortium and interact with international project partners. 

  • Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, reports, and the development of new research proposals.

 

Qualifications

The successful candidate should have:

  • MSc degree (or equivalent) in chemistry, environmental science, chemical engineering, computer science, data science, bioinformatics, or a related field. 

  • Strong interest in machine learning, cheminformatics, data science, and chemical risk assessment. 

  • Experience with programming in Python and scientific computing. 

  • Familiarity with machine learning methods, data management, and statistical analysis. 

  • Experience with chemical databases, molecular descriptors, QSAR models, or cheminformatics tools is an advantage. 

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English. 

  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an international research environment.

 

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology. The research environment conducts interdisciplinary research on the global and systemic interactions between materials, technologies, energy, the environment and society.

The Department of Green Technology is located in Odense, the main campus of the University of Southern Denmark. Odense offers an international research environment and an open Scandinavian working culture.

 

Further Information

Further information about the scientific content of the position is available from:

Zhanyun WangDIAS ProfessorDepartment of Green TechnologySDU Life Cycle EngineeringUniversity of Southern DenmarkEmail:  zwa@igt.sdu.dk 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 12, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.313 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

The preferred start date is in January 2026. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

title: Pattern Design Manager

YOUR TEAMYou'll become part of SELECTED's creative environment, where pattern design plays an important role in bringing our collections to life.Working closely with colleagues in Design and Buying, you and your team will turn design ideas into well-constructed garments, finding the right balance between creative intentions, fit, quality and commercial considerations.With responsibilities spanning both menswear and womenswear, you'll work with different perspectives and priorities, helping create a shared approach and strong collaboration across the two areas.

YOUR ROLEYou'll take responsibility for the team's performance and development while continuing to work hands-on with pattern development within your own product category.Beyond the day-to-day leadership, you'll drive projects, bring structure to shared priorities and help develop the technical standards and processes behind our collections.   • Driving projects and coordinating priorities across menswear and womenswear.

  • Working closely with Design and Buying to find solutions that meet both creative and commercial needs.

We work across disciplines, challenge each other's thinking and believe that good ideas can come from anywhere. It's an environment where you're encouraged to contribute your perspective and make your experience count.We also recognise that doing great work doesn't mean working the same way every day.
