title: Har du lyst å gjera "heima best" til ein realitet for våre tenestemottakarar ?
description:
Er du typen som trivest når ingen dagar er like? Brenn du for å skapa meistring, ser moglegheiter framfor begrensningar og er trygg i rolla di? Då er det kanskje akkurat deg vi leitar etter. 

- 100% stilling i turnus er ledig frå januar 2027.

Arbeidsstad: Tilrettelagte tenester gjev tenester til personar med ulike funksjonsnedsettingar, og Varafjell er kommunen sitt avlastingstilbod til foreldre med barn og unge med nedsatt funksjonsevne, og senteret ligg strategisk plassert i Industrivegen, nær idrettsanlegget på Kuventræ. Varafjell er ikkje berre ein arbeidsplass, vi er ryggrada i kvardagen til ein herleg gjeng med barn med ulike behov, draumar og personlegheit.

ArbeidsoppgåverHos oss skal jobben handla om livskvalitet. 

  • Miljøterapi i særklasse: Du er ei viktig brikke i tenestemottakaren sitt liv og må rekne med koordinator oppgåver. 
  • Fagleg frontfigur : Du får ansvar for tiltaksplanar, legemiddelhandsaming, oppfølging av Hol kap. 9, og syta for, saman med dine kollegaer, for at vi alltid held høg kvalitet
  • Glede og meistring: Du legg til rette for meistring og aktivitet ut ifrå tenestemottakarane sine eigne premisser
  • Samarbeid: Du jobbar tett med alle våre samarbeidspartnarar.
  • Deler av arbeidet vil verta utført ute i skule, der vi føljer barna.  

Kvalifikasjonar: 

  • Du er utdanna vernepleier eller sjukepleiar 
  • Du ser alltid mennesket før diagnosen
  • Du er en lagspelar som sprer energi i personalgruppa
  • Du tør å tenkja utanfor "boksen" når dei vanlege løysingane ikkje strekk til. 

Det viktigaste for oss er at du har eit varmt hjarte og eit godt fagleg blikk.

 Utanlandsk utdanning må vere godkjend av Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse (HK-dir): https://hkdir.no/utdanning-fra-utlandet 

Det kreves dokumenterte norskferdigheter på minimum nivå B2, både muntleg og skriftleg.  Vi gjer merksam på at du må leggja fram politiattest  

Kvifor velgje oss ? Her får du ikkje berre ein jobb, du får moglegheit til å utgjere den største forskjellen i nokon sitt liv. Du får en meiningsfull kvardag, der du kan sjå resultatet av jobben du gjer kvar einaste dag. Du får jobbe samen med engasjerte kollegaer som brenner for det same som deg. 

Vi tilbyr 

  • Faglege og personlege utfordringar i eit godt og inspirerande arbeidsmiljø
  • God pensjonsordning, yrkesskade- og gruppelivsforsikring
  • Løn etter gjeldande avtalar. For sjukepleiarar og vernepleiarar i pasientnært turnusarbeid, tilbyr Bjørnafjorden kommune eit tillegg i grunnløn på kr. 25.000,- over garantilønnstabell. Nyutdanna vernepleiar/sjukepleiar som har hatt stipendordning i Bjørnafjorden kommune, under utdanning, kan etter lokal ordning få tilbod om eingongsstipend på kr. 50.000,- ved oppstart i 100% fast stilling
  • Studentar under relevant utdanning er omfatta av eiga avlønning.
  • Vi arbeidar for å få etablert heiltidskultur i kommunen 

Bjørnafjorden kommune er ein arbeidsplass som verdset likestilling og mangfald, der alle tilsette forpliktar seg til prinsippet om likeverd og bidreg til å skapa eit inkluderande arbeidsmiljø. Vi ønskjer eit mangfald av søkjarar og oppmodar alle kvalifiserte kandidatar til å søkje, uavhengig av kjønn, alder, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, etnisk bakgrunn eller livssyn. Etter utløpt søknadsfrist, vil det bli generert ei offentleg søkjarliste med namn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og bustads- eller arbeidskommune for kvar søkjar. Det kan gjerast unntak frå innsyn for opplysningar om ein søkjar dersom vedkomande sjølv ber om det. Opplysningar om ein søkjar kan bli offentlege sjølv om ein har kryssa av for å bli unnateke. Dersom anmodningen ikkje vert tatt til følgje vil søkjaren bli varsla om det. 

Vi vil aldri be søkjar om å oppgi BANK-ID informasjon i søknadsprosessen. 

Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bjørnafjorden kommune har i overkant av 26 000 innbyggarar og rundt 1800 kommunalt tilsette. Vi er ein nær og varm kommune, noko som gjenspeglar seg i misjonen vår “Det gode liv for alle”. Som arbeidstakar bidrar du med oppgåver som er viktig for innbyggarane våre og lokalsamfunnet vårt. Du betyr noko, og det du gjer betyr noko! Vi jobbar med fleire spennande prosjekt, og er alltid på utkikk etter engasjerte folk med hjartet på rette staden. Er det deg?

title: Crazy nordlenning søker nye assistenter
description:
Vil du bli en viktig del av hverdagen min? Jeg er en 29 år gammel mann med cerebral parese, og jeg er på jakt etter en assistent som kan hjelpe meg med det daglige. Jeg elsker humor, musikk, gaming og alt som har med teknologi å gjøre. Hverdagen min er fylt med latter og gode samtaler, og jeg ser etter en person som jeg kan bli godt kjent med på sikt.

Hva går jobben ut på?Jeg trenger blant annet assistanse til:

  • Påkledning og personlig stell
  • Hjelp til forflytning
  • Assistere med bilkjøring (jeg har egen bil)
  • Hjelp til husarbeid, matlaging og baking
  • Hjelp til pass og stell av hund
  • Være med på sosiale aktiviteter
  • Ved mulighet, være med på reise rundt om i verden

Dette er ønskelig hos ny assistent:

  • Er positiv og kommer godt overens med nye mennesker
  • Har øye for detaljer og ser hva som må gjøres
  • Har førerkort og bil

Jeg håper også du er en person som har glimt i øyet, er fleksibel, punktlig og ryddig, og som snakker rett fra levra. Du bør også være glad i hunder!

Vi tilbyr

  • Fleksible arbeidstider med mulighet for tilkallingsvakter
  • Et støttende og variert arbeidsmiljø
  • Meningsfylt arbeid med stor betydning for meg
  • Lønn etter tariff

Jeg vil gjerne høre fra deg. Send meg en kort søknad hvor du forteller litt om hvem du er, hvorfor du ønsker jobben, og når du har mulighet til å jobbe.

Før eventuell ansettelse må det fremlegges politiattest, jf. helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven § 5-4. Attesten skal ikke være eldre enn tre måneder.

Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. Medvind Assistanse AS ble stiftet i 2020 og har lokale kontorer i store deler av landet.

title: 1352 Postdoctoral position in marine ecological modelling
description:
About the Position

The Institute of Marine Research (IMR) offers a 3-year postdoctoral position as part of the MORSE (“Models supporting practical restoration of habitats and species in Europe’s seas”) research project funded by Horizon Europe. This project sits within IMR’s strategic initiative to build a strong center for marine research within one of Europe's largest marine research institutes. The candidate will ideally start in early 2027. 

We seek a postdoctoral researcher with a background in ecological modelling, with relevant experience and publication record on modelling marine and/or aquatic ecosystems. The postdoctoral researcher will work across several work packages, including WP5 (reviewing and compiling data on restoration pathways, pressures, and ecological needs of focal species and habitats, and defining favourable reference areas), WP6 (species distribution modelling and assessment of environmental status (NEAT), WP7 (modelling land-, and sea-based pressures, and MPAs), and WP8 (modelling ecosystem services). The broader aim of the project is to develop and demonstrate effective and climate-resilient restoration models for European marine ecosystems to inform more effective restoration efforts. 

The postdoctoral researcher will work with a team of researchers at IMR and collaborating partners to carry out and deliver research outcomes in the MORSE project. The MORSE project that the postdoctoral position is associated with is a 4-year project that is led by the Finnish Environmental Institute (SYKE) and includes institutions across seven European countries (Finland, Sweden, Norway, UK, Spain, Portugal, and Greece). Travel to workshops and meetings in these countries should be anticipated. The postdoctoral researcher will gain mentoring support, training, and networking opportunities from the leading researchers associated with the MORSE project, and have the opportunity to establish connections and advance their research career over the course of the project. More information about MORSE can be found at the project website: https://morse-project.eu/ 

Knowledge about northern European marine ecosystems is an advantage, as the postdoctoral researcher will be responsible for modelling Norwegian marine ecosystems. The position is placed within the Benthic Communities research group and can be located at any of the IMR offices. Note that the IMR project lead (Karine Gagnon) is based at Flødevigen Research Station, but the research group includes members across all three locations. IMR has good links and cooperation with industry, management, and the university sector. We offer the opportunity to be part of a collaborative, interdisciplinary, and ambitious research group with strong national and international links.

Main tasks:

  • Lead and support MORSE research activities as directed by project leaders. 
  • Write research publications, reports, and grant proposals.
  • Participate in scientific conferences, science communication, and outreach activities. 
  • Review and compile existing data on restoration pathways, ecosystem status, and pressures for focal species and habitats, and define favourable reference areas for these 
  • Review and compile existing models and data sources for the Norwegian sea areas (including the Skagerrak, Norwegian Sea, North Sea, and Barents Sea) 
  • Apply species distribution models and assess environmental status using the NEAT tool 
  • Model land-based and sea-based pressures on marine habitats, and the role of MPAs 
  • Model climate scenarios and ecosystem services 
  • Participate in work package coordination and reporting 
  • Maintain and curate datasets and coordinate data sharing and modelling efforts across MORSE partners.
About the Research Group and Our Work

The Benthic Communities group focuses on research, mapping, and monitoring of benthic ecosystems, including seagrass meadows, macroalgae forests, and deep-sea ecosystems. Research within the project will support IMR’s national advisory task on ecosystem-based management of seas and coastal areas, where environmental changes and human activities and are important factors. The research group has over 30 employees base on Flødevigen, Bergen, and Tromsø.

Qualification Requirements

For this position, we are looking for a candidate with

  • PhD in biology or ecology, preferably with a focus on ecological modelling
  • Documented experience in ecological modelling 
  • Strong publication record in international peer-reviewed journals
  • Excellent written and oral skills in English

The working language at the Institute of Marine Research is Norwegian. Being able to communicate well in Norwegian is an important prerequisite for both the employee and our institute. We expect non-Norwegian-speaking employees to complete Norwegian language courses during the first two years of employment. The institute will cover the cost of completed and passed Norwegian courses.

Personal Qualities

At the Institute of Marine Research, we believe that personality plays a role in how one works, communicates, and thrives in the workplace. For this position, we are looking for a colleague who

  • Good communication and collaboration skills. 
  • Good organisational and logistics skills. 
  • Ability to complete work on time and meeting deadline 
  • Ability to work efficiently independently and in teams.
Desired Qualifications
  • Strong skills and experience in ecological modelling and data analysis
  • Ability and willingness to collaborate with colleagues in Norway and abroad 
  • Ability and willingness to organize and lead joint modelling efforts with partners abroad 
  • Research experience in marine ecosystems, species, and habitats 
  • Research experience in ecological restoration and/or conservation
Inclusion and Diversity is a Strength

The Institute of Marine Research believes that inclusion and diversity are strengths. Therefore, we encourage all qualified candidates to apply for a position with us, regardless of age, gender, disability, nationality, or ethnic background. The Institute is an Inclusive Workplace (IA) company, and we aim to accommodate applicants with disabilities.

If there are qualified applicants with disabilities, employment gaps, or immigrant backgrounds, we will invite at least one applicant from each of these groups to an interview. To be considered for affirmative action, you must meet the requirements and indicate that you wish to be considered for the action in your application. You can read more here.

Your application must include 

• a cover letter describing your research interests and motivation for applying for the position. The letter should not exceed one A4 page.• Full name and contact details for two or three referees, preferably your PhD supervisor and/or references from recent employment.• CV, transcripts, diplomas, and relevant certificates.• A list of scientific publications, if applicable.

All documents must be in a Scandinavian language or in English. Candidates with documentation from foreign institutions must include an explanation of the institution’s grading system.

We offer
  • the opportunity to work in one of Europe’s leading marine research institutes
  • a creative working environment
  • facilities in either Flødevigen, Bergen or Tromsø 
  • flexible work hours
  • public sector occupational pension through the Norwegian Public Service Pension Funds (SPK)
  • access to company cabins, fitness facilities, and other welfare benefits
Aditional information

The position is remunerated as 1352 Postdoctoral in accordance with the main collective agreement in the state sector, depending on your qualifications and the characteristics of the position. A 2 % contribution to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted from the salary.

Applications must be submitted electronically via Jobbnorge.

Please note that information about applicants may be made public even if the applicant has requested not to be listed. Applicants will be informed in advance if such disclosure is necessary.

The Institute of Marine Research is subject to export control regulations. These regulations apply to the processing of applications for the position.

Applicants with education from abroad may be asked to provide NOKUT approval of their qualifications. You may be asked to approve that the Institute of Marine Research conducts a background check.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The Institute of Marine Research is one of Europe’s largest marine research institutes, with over 1,000 employees and a range of high-standard research facilities and laboratories. Our main activities are research, advisory work, and monitoring. The institute owns and operates eight research vessels. Our headquarters are in Bergen, with additional offices in Tromsø and research stations in Matre, Austevoll, and Flødevigen.The Institute of Marine Research aims to be a leading provider of knowledge to ensure the sustainable management of marine ecosystem resources—nationally and internationally—across the entire value chain from ocean to food, including the marine environment, fish nutrition, and safe, healthy seafood.

title: Aktiv og sporty mann i 50 årene søker assistenter i Voss.
description:
Jeg er en ungdommelig og aktiv mann i 50 årene som ser etter flinke, initiativrike og stabile assistenter som kan bistå meg i hverdagen. Jeg bor i eget hus med samboer og tre barn. Jeg trives med en aktiv hverdag og liker blant annet å trene på treningssenter, drive med fysisk arbeid ute som blant annet vedlikehold av hus og hage. På fritiden er jeg også glad i å fiske, ATV-turer på fjellet og dra på teltturer ute i naturen.

For meg er det viktig å ha assistenter som ønsker å delta i en aktiv hverdag, og som kan bidra til at jeg får gjennomført aktiviteter og gjøremål jeg selv ønsker. Du trenger ikke å dele alle av mine interesser, men det er en fordel at du liker å være ute og ikke er redd for å ta i et tak. Det er også viktig at du kler deg etter vær og vind – her er det ikke dårlig vær, bare dårlige klær! 😊

Jeg har behov for assistanse til både personlige og praktiske gjøremål. Dette innebærer blant annet følge til avtaler hos fysioterapeut, trening på treningssenter og gjennomføring av treningsopplegg i basseng.

Hjemme bruker jeg manuell rullestol, mens jeg benytter elektrisk rullestol når jeg er ute. Jeg har stor bil med automatgir, så det er en fordel om du har førerkort, da det vil være behov for at du kan bistå meg med kjøring til ulike aktiviteter og avtaler.

Arbeidsoppgaver vil blant annet være:

  • Følge til og fra ulike avtaler, som lege og fysioterapeut.
  • Bistå i forbindelse med trening, reiser og fritidsaktiviteter.
  • Matlaging og tilrettelegging av måltider.
  • Husarbeid og praktiske oppgaver i hus og hage.
  • Bistand til personlig stell og daglige gjøremål.

Jeg ser etter deg som:

  • Er aktiv, omgjengelig og har godt humør.
  • Er initiativrik, selvstendig og løsningsorientert.
  • Er tålmodig, pålitelig og tillitsskapende.
  • Er flink til å motivere og bidra til en aktiv hverdag.
  • Er observant og ser hva som trenger å gjøres.
  • Er fleksibel og trives med varierte arbeidsoppgaver.

Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.

Arbeidstid og stillingsstørrelse

Jeg søker nå etter:

  • Én assistent i 50 % stilling.
  • Én assistent i 30 % stilling.
  • Tilkallingsvikarer som kan stille opp ved behov.

Arbeidstiden vil hovedsakelig være på dagtid, men noe arbeid på kveld og helg må kunne påregnes.

Søknad frist : Snarest, søknader vurderes fortløpende.

Krav i stillingen:

  • Plettfri vandel/politiattest
  • Gode norskkunnskaper
  • Førerkort

Emosjonelle krav:

I jobben som personlig assistent i JAG stilles det emosjonelle krav. Emosjonelle krav handler om de følelsesmessige kravene som stilles til arbeidstaker i møte med andre. Håndtering av egne og andres følelser er en viktig del av jobben. I rollen som personlig assistent kan man komme i situasjoner hvor man må justere og/eller beherske egne følelser, samt håndtere andre menneskers følelser inkludert sorger og gleder. Det vil være ulike krav i de ulike BPA-ordningene, dette gås gjennom på intervju og ved praktisk opplæring på arbeidsplassen.

Som personlig assistent i JAG utgjør du en forskjell hver dag, og personlig egnethet er avgjørende.

Lønn:

Når du søker på stillingen må du legge ved både søknad og en utfyllende CV.

CV må inneholde både arbeidsgiver, stillingstittel, stillingsstørrelse og ansettelsens varighet (måned/år). Dette må fremkomme tydelig i CV.

For riktig lønnsfastsettelse: dersom du har relevant erfaring/utdannelse vil du ved en eventuell ansettelse i JAG bes om å fremlegge denne dokumentasjonen. Relevant erfaring må tilsvare minimum 50% stilling pr år.

Relevant erfaring kan være:

  • BPA-assistent
  • Barne- og ungdomsarbeider
  • Førskolelærer
  • Helsefagarbeider

JAG Assistanse har Tariffavtale (Landsoverenskomst for BPA).

Timelønn ved 35,5 t/u _______________________________________________

Ansiennitet | 0 år | 3 år | 6 år | 9 år | Timelønn kr | 236,49 | 241,91 | 250,04 | 258,16 |

______________________________________________

Tillegg for ubekvem arbeidstid

Kveld og natt: kr 67,00Helg: kr 70,00

Kveld/natt- og helgetillegg ihht. tariffavtalen.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

JAG Assistanse AS (JAG) er en ideell leverandør av brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA) og styrer etter non-profitt prinsippet. JAG har bred kompetanse på organisering av BPA-tjenester, spesielt for personer med sammensatte funksjonsnedsettelser, hvorav en kan være av kognitiv art. Vi arbeider for at alle uavhengig av funksjonsnedsettelse skal kunne leve sine liv fullt ut på egne vilkår, og skreddersyr hver enkelt BPA-ordning.

JAG er landsdekkende og arbeidsgiver for over 1000 ansatte, og det legges stor vekt på kvalitetssikring, opplæring og videreutvikling. Verdigrunnlaget i JAG bygger på Independent Living og grunnleggende menneskerettigheter, som også gjenspeiles i JAGs kulturkode.

title: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description: Operations and techniciansTeamlead Reliability EngineersImagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. title: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description: Operations and techniciansTeamlead Reliability EngineersImagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.Pre-employment background checks:For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

description:
Kundeservicerådgiver for Audi. Vi har opstart den 1. november med mulighed for firmabolig.

Er du klar til at tage springet og blive en del af en global digital organisation, der leverer support i verdensklasse?

Vi søger en kunderådgiver til en spændende rolle med Audi – en af Europas mest ikoniske bilproducenter. Stillingen er 100 % remote fra Portugal, og du bliver en nøglespiller i et internationalt team, der sikrer en ekstraordinær kunderejse for Audi’s brugere.

Hvad laver en Kundeservicerådgiver?

Som kundeservicerådgiver er du kundens direkte kontaktpunkt og hjælper med alt fra bilteknologi til digitale funktioner og serviceydelser. Du skaber en professionel oplevelse med struktur, empati og høj kvalitet i centrum.

Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Besvarelse af henvendelser via telefon, e-mail og chat

  • Fejlsøgning af tekniske problemer og vejledning i bilsystemer

  • Registrering af kundeinteraktioner i CRM-systemet

  • Opdatering på Audi’s produkter og politikker

  • Aktiv deltagelse i teamets deling af best practices

Dine kvalifikationer:

Vi leder efter dig, hvis du:

  • Taler og skriver dansk + har et minimum B2-niveau i engelsk

  • Har erfaring med kundeservice – gerne fra bilbranchen

  • Har teknisk flair og interesse for digitale løsninger

  • Kan kommunikere tydeligt, løse problemer og skabe tillid

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav – vi opfordrer dig stadig til at søge!

Vi tilbyder:

  • Mulighed for firmabolig i Braga

  • Konkurrencedygtig grundløn plus bonusordning

  • Professionelle udviklingsmuligheder

  • Et samarbejdende og støttende arbejdsmiljø

  • Adgang til eksklusive rejsefordele og rabatter

  • Restaurantkort

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring

  • 14 lønudbetalinger om året

Fordele ved at arbejde i en international virksomhed i Portugal

  • Udvidelse af dine faglige kompetencer gennem globalt samarbejde

  • Forbedring af kommunikation og salgsteknikker i et internationalt miljø

  • Mulighed for karriereudvikling inden for kundeservice, salg og rejsebranchen

  • Adgang til et netværk af internationale kolleger og brancheeksperter

  • Erfaring med moderne digitale værktøjer til kundehåndtering

Dette er en unik mulighed for at kombinere en stærk erhvervserfaring med en fleksibel arbejdsmodel.

Fordele ved at arbejde fra Portugal

  • Mildt klima året rundt – Portugal har et behageligt middelhavsklima med varme somre og milde vintre, hvilket gør det til en attraktiv destination for dem, der ønsker at bo og arbejde i et solrigt land

  • Lavere leveomkostninger – Sammenlignet med mange andre europæiske lande er leveomkostningerne i Portugal relativt lave, hvilket giver mulighed for en høj livskvalitet til en rimelig pris.

  • Høj livskvalitet – Portugal er kendt for sin afslappede livsstil, gode mad og venlige lokalbefolkning, hvilket skaber et positivt og behageligt arbejdsmiljø.

  • God infrastruktur og moderne faciliteter – Portugal har en stærk digital infrastruktur, moderne kontorfaciliteter og gode transportmuligheder, hvilket sikrer en behagelig arbejdsdag.

  • Adgang til smukke strande og natur – Portugal tilbyder nem adgang til fantastiske strande, naturskønne områder og en rig kulturarv, som kan opleves både i fritiden og weekenderne.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer: Ai Solution Architect (f/m/d) (Informatiker/in)
description: As a Senior AI Solution Architect in our Forward Deployed Engineering team, you see the whole board before a single line of code is written. You partner directly with business leaders across Siemens to map complex challenges to existing data, design cross-platform architectures spanning cloud and enterprise systems, and make critical build-versus-buy decisions in days rather than quarters. You bridge deep technical AI expertise with systems thinking, acting as a force multiplier that enables agile engineering teams to deliver high-impact solutions reliably and repeatedly.What we offer you:- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interestsSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.You’ll make an impact by:- Driving rapid solution architecture as the first technical expert in every engagement, translating complex business problems into viable technical blueprints within days. - Designing interconnected solutions across the entire enterprise landscape, leveraging SDC for workloads while integrating seamlessly with SAP, Salesforce, and cloud-native services. - Owning crucial architecture decisions regarding cost, latency, scalability, and stack selection, while documenting clear justifications for every trade-off. - Evaluating emerging AI technologies with rigorous skepticism, providing evidence-backed adoption recommendations and having the courage to say "not ready yet." - Staying actively involved in the codebase through technical spikes, prototype development, and pull-request reviews to ensure your architectures remain grounded in reality. - Designing from day one for seamless handover, establishing explicit interface contracts, evaluation harnesses, and operational runbooks so domain teams can run systems autonomously.Your defining qualities:- Education: You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or a comparable quantitative field, where a proven track record of shipped systems outweighs advanced degrees. - Experience & Skills:- You bring 8 or more years of experience in software architecture, AI/ML systems design, or solution architecture, including at least 3 years focused on complex enterprise AI solutions. - You demonstrate a robust history of customer-facing delivery and technical leadership, especially when navigating demanding or high-pressure stakeholder environments. - You posses hands-on coding capabilities in Python alongside TypeScript or JavaScript, allowing you to write production-grade code and build functional prototypes. - You provide expertise in cross-platform system design by successfully integrating disparate enterprise environments like SAP, Salesforce, and modern cloud services. - You exhibit deep knowledge of the modern AI stack, covering LLM failure modes, RAG architectures, evaluation metrics, vector stores, and prominent agent frameworks. - You bring working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP) sufficient to design scalable multi-platform workloads.- Ways of working:- You demonstrate the critical ability to evaluate emerging technologies objectively, separate genuine value from hype, and communicate technical realities clearly. - You display exceptional live communication skills to sketch defensible architectures in real-time meetings and explain them fluently in business terms.- Languages: You have fluent English language skills, complemented by strong German proficiency as an advantageous asset for local stakeholder engagements.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usWe know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? title: Pracovníci v oblasti predaja inde neuvedení
description:
V zime máme pre vás pripravenú pracovnú pozíciu, pri ktorej sa budete stretávať so zákazníkmi, ktorí si prišli aktívne zašportovať a oddýchnuť si na lyžiach, snowboarde alebo sa vybrať na skialp. Vašou úlohou bude poradiť im s výberom výstroje, ktorá je pre nich vhodná, a správne ju nastaviť. Aj v požičovni u nás vládne skvelá nálada, pretože práve tá je naším hlavným meradlom pri výbere správnych kolegov na všetky pozície v rezorte. Ak teda radi pomáhate ľuďom, máte zmysel pre precíznosť a spĺňate parameter „vždy dobrá nálada", berieme vás medzi nás.

Náplň práce:

požičiavanie a servis lyžiarskej výstroje a športových potrieb,

aktívny predaj a komunikácia s klientmi,

práca s peniazmi a registračnou pokladňou,

kontrola kvality a poškodenia výstroje s následným zabezpečením opravy, servisu, prípadne vyradenia.

Ak chcete stráviť zimu na horách, medzi ľuďmi, ktorí majú lyžovanie v krvi, tešíme sa na Vás.Výhody:ubytovanie

title: Inštruktori a cvičitelia športových rekreačných aktivít
description:
Predstavte si, že nastúpite do tímu 30 mladých ľudí a vašou najťažšou pracovnou úlohou bude... nájsť si medzi nimi nových kamarátov a kolegov. Cez deň budete v Ski school Strachan učiť ľudí prvé (alebo posledné pred pádom) oblúky na lyžiach či snowboarde, a večer, keď sa lekcie skončia, sa z vás aj z celého personálu Strachan Resortu stanú hviezdy parketu, teda skôr stola, v Medveďom brlohu.

Inštruktorom lyžovania alebo snowboardingu sa môžete stať aj bez skúseností, po kurze, na ktorý vám finančne prispejeme, pretože veríme, že najlepšia motivácia je zalyžovať si zadarmo na svahoch Ski centra Strachan aj Ski centra Strednica (a nie len teoreticky vedieť, kde je tá modrá zjazdovka). Máte radi voľnosť a flexibilitu? Do práce vás u nás nikto naháňať nebude, k nám sa chodí s nadšením, a to je presne to, čo na vás naši hostia uvidia už na prvom kruhu.

Zamestnanecké výhody a benefity:

práca v tíme mladých ľudí, s ktorými sa dá prežiť aj lyžovačka, aj afterpárty,

nádherné prostredie Belianskych Tatier, kancelária s výhľadom, o akom sa iným môže len snívať,

flexibilný pracovný čas, žiadne nútené vstávanie, len dobrovoľné,

mzda od 8 €/hod. v čistom

zľavy na služby v Strachan Resorte,

možnosť absolvovať inštruktorský kurz s dotáciou a zvýhodnením, takže sa naučíte lyžovať aj zarábať súčasne.

Ak vás táto predstava neodstrašuje, ale naopak láka, poznáte odpoveď. Prihláste sa k nám a staňte sa súčasťou tímu, ktorý cez deň učí a večer tancuje.Výhody:ubytovanie

title: Špecialisti v oblasti reklamy a marketingu
description:
☎️ „Dobrý deň, máme problém.“

„Aký?“

„Technický.“

„A čo presne nefunguje?“

„No... ono.“

Výborne. Máme prvú stopu. 

Ak dokážeš z takéhoto rozhovoru dostať použiteľné informácie, možno máme prácu presne pre teba.

Prijímanie technických incidentov – „Môžete mi to stručne opísať?“ Nasleduje audiokniha.

Kontrola monitorovacích systémov – sleduješ, čo funguje, čo nefunguje a čo sa len veľmi presvedčivo tvári, že funguje.

Riešenie jednoduchších technických problémov – keď problém vyriešiš za minútu, zvyšných 59 nemusíš predstierať, že to bolo náročné.

Posúvanie zložitejších prípadov na vyššiu podporu – keď problém potrebuje väčšieho odborníka, pošleš ho ďalej. Nie však s popisom „nejde to, veľa šťastia“.

Komunikácia so zákazníkmi a technickými tímami – vieš zostať slušná/ý aj pri vete „Ale susedovi to funguje“.

Práca s Excelom a evidencia incidentov – keď ti Excel napíše #HODNOTA!, neodpovieš mu niečím, čo by HR muselo cenzurovať.

Sledovanie otvorených požiadaviek – nenecháš incident ležať v systéme tak dlho, až dostane nárok na dôchodok.

Dokumentovanie vyriešených problémov – aby sa rovnaká chyba nemusela vyšetrovať každý pondelok ako nový kriminálny prípad.

Výhody:Pracovný pomer bez dátumu spotreby – nie sme reality šou. Každý piatok nikoho nevyraďujeme.  Zmluva na dobu neurčitú 

Permanentka na dobrovoľné sebatrýznenie – fitko, bazén, sauna... Vyber si, kde sa budeš potiť a ešte za to poďakuješ.  MultiSport karta 

Decembrové úplatky za celoročné dobré správanie – darčeky dostaneš, aj keď si občas zanadávaš na pondelok.  Vianočné balíčky 

Keď je problém, nehráme schovávačku – kolegovia ti pomôžu. Nikto zázračne neodíde na obed na tri dni.  100 percent podpora zo strany firmy 

Kolektív bez povinného firemného úsmevu – môžeš byť normálny človek, nie nadšený komparzista z reklamy na jogurt.  Rodinná atmosféra 

Žiadna výroba zamestnancov cez kopirák – každý máme svoje muchy. Niektorí rovno celé safari.  Individuálny prístup

description:
Hľadáme šikovného a spoľahlivého kuchára/kuchárku s vášňou pre gastronómiu, ktorý/á by chcel/a pôsobiť v úspešnom tíme reštaurácie Medvedí brloh. Príprava sezónnych a regionálnych špecialít z kvalitných surovín

Práca v tíme profesionálnych kuchárov pod vedením skúseného šéfkuchára.

Pracovné zmeny: krátky/dlhý týždeň alebo podľa dohody

title: Čašníci a someliéri
description:
V Strachan Resorte v Ždiari nespájame len tradičnú goralskú pohostinnosť s prémiovou kvalitou, ale vytvárame pre našich hostí zážitky. Naša reštaurácia je známa skvelou gastronómiou, rodinnou atmosférou a dychberúcimi výhľadmi na Belianske Tatry. Hľadáme do nášho tímu profesionála, pre ktorého nie je gastronómia len prácou, ale srdcovou záležitosťou.

Náplň práce:

Profesionálna a ústretová obsluha hostí v reštaurácii.

Aktívny predaj našich špecialít, prémiových vín a destilátov (radi ťa do všetkého zasvätíme).

Prestieranie stolov, udržiavanie čistoty a poriadku na rajóne.

Práca s pokladničným systémom a hotovosťou/terminálom.

Komunikácia s kuchyňou s cieľom zabezpečiť plynulý servis.

Reprezentovanie dobrého mena Strachan Resortu úsmevom a proaktívnym prístupom.Výhody:ubytovanie

title: Pracovníci v oblasti predaja inde neuvedení
description:
V zime máme pre vás pripravenú pracovnú pozíciu, pri ktorej sa budete stretávať so zákazníkmi, ktorí si prišli aktívne zašportovať a oddýchnuť si na lyžiach, snowboarde alebo sa vybrať na skialp. Vašou úlohou bude poradiť im s výberom výstroje, ktorá je pre nich vhodná, a správne ju nastaviť. Aj v požičovni u nás vládne skvelá nálada, pretože práve tá je naším hlavným meradlom pri výbere správnych kolegov na všetky pozície v rezorte. Ak teda radi pomáhate ľuďom, máte zmysel pre precíznosť a spĺňate parameter „vždy dobrá nálada", berieme vás medzi nás.

Náplň práce:

požičiavanie a servis lyžiarskej výstroje a športových potrieb,

aktívny predaj a komunikácia s klientmi,

práca s peniazmi a registračnou pokladňou,

kontrola kvality a poškodenia výstroje s následným zabezpečením opravy, servisu, prípadne vyradenia.

Ak chcete stráviť zimu na horách, medzi ľuďmi, ktorí majú lyžovanie v krvi, tešíme sa na Vás.Výhody:ubytovanie

description:
Do nášho tímu hľadáme nového kolegu/kolegyňu, ktorý/á bude mať na starosti predaj skipasov v pokladni v lyžiarskom stredisku v Ždiari. Ak máš rád/a ľudí, si veselá kopa s pozitívnym prístupom a neplašia ťa čísla ani pokladňa, si u nás správne.

Náplň práce:

predaj skipasov a poskytovanie informácií hosťom,

práca s pokladničným systémom,

vykonávanie denných uzávierok,

zodpovednosť za zverené finančné prostriedky,

odovzdávanie tržieb podľa stanovených postupov.

Požadujeme:

príjemné vystupovanie a komunikatívnosť,

spoľahlivosť a zodpovedný prístup pri práci s peniazmi,

ochotu pracovať aj cez víkendy a sviatky, v sezóne je u nás totiž najviac veselo,

Ak ťa baví práca s ľuďmi a chceš byť súčasťou tímu, vďaka ktorému má každý deň na svahu ten správny začiatok, tešíme sa na Vás.Výhody:ubytovanie

title: Inštruktori a cvičitelia športových rekreačných aktivít
description:
Predstavte si, že nastúpite do tímu 30 mladých ľudí a vašou najťažšou pracovnou úlohou bude... nájsť si medzi nimi nových kamarátov a kolegov. Cez deň budete v Ski school Strachan učiť ľudí prvé (alebo posledné pred pádom) oblúky na lyžiach či snowboarde, a večer, keď sa lekcie skončia, sa z vás aj z celého personálu Strachan Resortu stanú hviezdy parketu, teda skôr stola, v Medveďom brlohu.

Inštruktorom lyžovania alebo snowboardingu sa môžete stať aj bez skúseností, po kurze, na ktorý vám finančne prispejeme, pretože veríme, že najlepšia motivácia je zalyžovať si zadarmo na svahoch Ski centra Strachan aj Ski centra Strednica (a nie len teoreticky vedieť, kde je tá modrá zjazdovka). Máte radi voľnosť a flexibilitu? Do práce vás u nás nikto naháňať nebude, k nám sa chodí s nadšením, a to je presne to, čo na vás naši hostia uvidia už na prvom kruhu.

Zamestnanecké výhody a benefity:

práca v tíme mladých ľudí, s ktorými sa dá prežiť aj lyžovačka, aj afterpárty,

nádherné prostredie Belianskych Tatier, kancelária s výhľadom, o akom sa iným môže len snívať,

flexibilný pracovný čas, žiadne nútené vstávanie, len dobrovoľné,

mzda od 8 €/hod. v čistom

zľavy na služby v Strachan Resorte,

možnosť absolvovať inštruktorský kurz s dotáciou a zvýhodnením, takže sa naučíte lyžovať aj zarábať súčasne.

Ak vás táto predstava neodstrašuje, ale naopak láka, poznáte odpoveď. Prihláste sa k nám a staňte sa súčasťou tímu, ktorý cez deň učí a večer tancuje.Výhody:ubytovanie

description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha!

Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä:

- pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne
- administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie
- pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia
- upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu
- vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď
- výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia

Rozvrh pracovného času 

Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​

Kto sme? 

Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity.

Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností?

Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami.

title: Senior Solution Architect (f/m/d)  IT/OT Security Platforms (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
description: Together, we make the differenceSiemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.As a Solution Architect (f/m/d) for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts.As part of our team, you will have- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interestsSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.What part will you play?- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security Platforms (SINEC Secure Connect), ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements. - You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases. - You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints. - You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps. - You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens. - You define integration concepts between connectivity services, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems. - You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape. - You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability. - You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services.What you bring to the table- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification. - Experience & Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443. - You have proven experience with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures. - You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps. - You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design. - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- Ways of working:- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments. - You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).- Languages: Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usWe know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority.Our global,diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs.html) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/jobs/faq/) – if you need further information on the application process.

title: Senior Solution Architect (f/m/d)  IT/OT Security Platforms (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
description: Together, we make the differenceSiemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.As a Solution Architect (f/m/d) for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts.As part of our team, you will have- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interestsSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.What part will you play?- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security Platforms (SINEC Secure Connect), ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements. - You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases. - You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints. - You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps. - You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens. - You define integration concepts between connectivity services, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems. - You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape. - You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability. - You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services.What you bring to the table- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification. - Experience & Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443. - You have proven experience with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures. - You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps. - You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design. - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- Ways of working:- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments. - You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).- Languages: Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usWe know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority.Our global,diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs.html) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/jobs/faq/) – if you need further information on the application process.

title: (Associate) Vice President (f/m/d) - Siemens Advanta (Physiker/in)
description: As an (Associate) Vice President (f/m/d) at Siemens Advanta’s Strategy and Innovation Practice, you will serve as a senior leader overseeing pivotal domains: Delivery, Business Development, and People & Capability Building. Leveraging advanced expertise and leadership acumen, you will help define the next era of digitalization by crafting groundbreaking strategies and transformation roadmaps for Siemens and its global customers. The role entails direct responsibility for shaping business success, managing high-value projects, and serving as a trusted advisor for customer executives at C-level.Building on Siemens Advanta’s legacy as a global management consultancy powerhouse, the (Associate) Vice President role combines strategic depth, operational ownership, and cultural leadership—providing exposure to innovation-driven industries such as electrification, automation, and digitalization. **Ready to take your vision to the next level? Be part of a team where strategy meets technology, and innovation drives global impact.**How you will make an impact with us:- Delivery Excellence:- Act as a trusted advisor to our customers, shaping strategic agendas and transformation roadmaps with your thought leadership.- Take operational and financial responsibility for acquiring and delivering high quality projects.- Oversee multidisciplinary teams in complex consulting engagements and large-scale programs to deliver innovative, tailored digital and organizational solutions for global industrial customers.- Business Growth:- Shape strategic customer opportunities through thought leadership, innovative methodologies, and differentiated consulting approaches at the intersection of strategy, digitalization, and technology.- Lead the development of compelling value propositions, proposals, and solution concepts for complex transformation initiatives in close collaboration with Customer Partners and senior customer stakeholders.- Build trusted relationships with C-level executives, acting as a strategic advisor and fostering long-term partnerships across complex stakeholder environments.- Leverage Siemens’ unique expertise in industrial technology, automation, digitalization, and AI to create measurable value for customers and strengthen Siemens Advanta’s market positioning and growth.- People & Capability Building- Develop differentiating methodologies, foster team growth, mentor employees, and build Consulting Excellence within the organization.- Inspire, coach, and grow high-performing, diverse teams ensuring an inclusive, performance-oriented consulting culture.What you bring:- Education: - Master’s degree or MBA from a top-tier university is desirable.- Backgrounds in engineering, physics, natural sciences, or strategic management are highly valued.- Experience & Skills- Extensive consulting experience (8 - 12+ years), with a proven track record as Principal, (Associate) Partner or VP at a top-tier strategy consultancy, or equivalent experience in corporate strategy roles.- Track record in driving significant business growth**,** leading large-scale transformation programs, and building executive-level customer relationships.- Proven track record in leading digital transformation projects for Siemens’ customer base, focusing on industries like automotive and power & utilities.- AI expertise: Strong familiarity with AI-based strategy development and execution, leveraging AI to create impactful industry transformations.- End-to-end experience, ranging from strategy development to hands-on execution for technology-driven and industry-specific transformation projects.- Methodological depth in areas such as Target Operating Model (TOM), cost reduction initiatives, sustainability, and AI transformation.- Working Style & Personality- Ability to thrive in a matrix organization, fostering strong internal partnerships and cross-functional collaboration.- Extensive experience leading international teams and actively creating an inclusive environment.- A leader who develops people, enjoys leading employees, brings diverse perspectives, thinks creatively, and goes beyond standard consulting approaches.- An entrepreneurial mindset and strong analytical acumen.- Languages: The position can be filled in either Munich,Germany or Barcelona,Spain.- Pathway 1: For candidates working in Munich and supporting primarily German-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in English is mandatory, while German is an advantage.- Pathway 2: For candidates working in Barcelona and supporting primarily Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in Spanish is mandatory, with proficiency in Portugese preferred.What we offer you- Attractive Compensation Package: A competitive salary that recognizes your expertise and performance.- Flexible Working Models: Enjoy time for yourself and your family through our flexible working hour models.- Continuous Learning: Benefit from specialized training and daily challenges to keep your expert knowledge up-to-date.- Innovative Environment: Become part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvement.Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usSiemens Advanta provides consulting services in the fields of strategy, operations, AI, and data analytics, as well as solution implementation services, to enable the digital and sustainability transformation of Siemens customers. Leveraging Siemens’ expertise, resources, and its ecosystem of businesses and partners, customers are empowered to unlock the full potential of Siemens technologies. Siemens Advanta elevates customer engagements to an enterprise level, leading transformations through strategic insight and holistic solutions. With pioneering projects bridging across Siemens’ entire portfolio, customers are enabled to leverage the full value of Siemens technologies. description: Auxiliar de mantenimientoDescripción de la empresaNuestro corazón es turquesa.Trabajar para Motel One es como estar en casa de un amigo, donde el reconocimiento y el apoyo gozan de la máxima importancia y las cualidades personales son bien acogidas. Nos tratamos de igual a igual y formamos equipo: desde la dirección hasta los becarios.Con nuestra pasión conjunta por el diseño moderno y la alta calidad de servicio, creamos un hogar para nuestros huéspedes en Motel One. Nuestros más de 115 hoteles en 13 países impresionan por su diseño exclusivo, los altos estándares de servicio y las ubicaciones privilegiadas en el centro urbano, siempre a un precio atractivo.Como fundadores y embajadores del concepto de diseño asequible, nos estamos expandiendo con éxito por las ciudades de Europa y más allá. Únase a nuestro equipo y demos forma juntos a Motel One.Descripción del empleoReparaciones, pintura, protección contra incendios, seguridad en el trabajo... Como técnico todoterreno de nuestro hotel, se asegurará de que todo funcione correctamente. Por lo tanto, usted será responsable de:- Realizar un recorrido diario por las instalaciones para detectar cualquier defecto en el hotel y realizar los trabajos de reparación y renovación correspondientes- Hacer un seguimiento del correcto funcionamiento de los equipos, ascensores e instalaciones técnicas del hotel- Garantizar la limpieza y el mantenimiento de todas las zonas al aire libre- Actuar como enlace de comunicación y cooperación con empresas externas, controlando especialmente cualquier trabajo de mantenimiento- Adquirir conocimientos interdepartamentales sobre nuevas áreas de actividad mediante el trabajo en nuestros equipos multiculturalesBenefits:- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.Requisitos¿Es usted un profesional del mundo de los hoteles y se considera un manitas o es una persona con conocimientos de mantenimiento a la que le encantan los hoteles? Si es así, ¡este puesto es perfecto para usted! ¡La personalidad y los dotes de anfitrión son nuestra prioridad! También tendrá que reunir los siguientes requisitos:- Tener formación técnica y/o tener experiencia profesional en uno o más puestos relacionados con el mantenimiento de edificios o estar buscando un cambio de carrera profesional- Ser una persona abierta y comunicativa, prestar atención a los detalles y tener interés por la tecnología- Ser una persona flexible y creativa, y tener un excelente sentido de la calidad, incluso en situaciones de estrés- Ser una persona a la que le guste trabajar en equipo y que esté dispuesta a proporcionar asistencia en todos los departamentos: ¡en Motel One, los objetivos son conjuntos, así que nos ayudamos entre todos!

title: Senior Solution Architect (f/m/d)  IT/OT Security Platforms (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
description: Together, we make the differenceSiemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.As a Solution Architect (f/m/d) for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts.As part of our team, you will have- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interestsSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.What part will you play?- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security Platforms (SINEC Secure Connect), ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements. - You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases. - You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints. - You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps. - You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens. - You define integration concepts between connectivity services, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems. - You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape. - You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability. - You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services.What you bring to the table- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification. - Experience & Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443. - You have proven experience with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures. - You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps. - You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design. - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- Ways of working:- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments. - You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).- Languages: Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work.
