title: Process Engineer
description: Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.What you'll doRight now, we are looking for a Process Engineer – Direct Reduction for our Green Iron Operations. The team is responsible for optimizing process performance, supporting safe and stable operations, and driving continuous improvements across our hydrogen production and direct reduction plants.Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following, but as we are a growing company with very few silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.    Provide day-to-day process engineering support to ensure safe, stable, and efficient plant operations.    Monitor plant performance, troubleshoot process upsets, and lead root cause analyses to improve reliability and operational excellence.    Optimize process performance through process modelling, heat and mass balances, debottlenecking, and energy efficiency initiatives.    Support direct reduction operations during commissioning, start-ups, shutdowns, and operational changes.    Review and develop engineering documentation, including PFDs, P&IDs, process calculations, SOPs, and process control strategies.    Collaborate with Operations, Maintenance, Automation, and OEM partners to improve process performance and implement engineering solutions.    Drive continuous improvement projects, monitor production KPIs, and prepare technical reports to support data-driven decision-making.    Promote safe operations by supporting process safety activities, hydrogen safety standards, PTW/LOTO compliance, and technical training.What you'll bringYou're curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You're not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking—and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.Specific to this role, we'd like to see that you bring:    A degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, or another relevant engineering discipline.    Solid process engineering experience from an operating, commercial-scale Direct Reduction plant.    Experience supporting commissioning, start-ups, process optimization, or operational improvements in an industrial setting.    A strong understanding of process engineering fundamentals, with the ability to analyse complex systems and turn insights into practical solutions.    Experience with hydrogen production is a plus. Curiosity about the hydrogen process and a willingness to learn are important.    Confidence working across disciplines and collaborating with Operations, Maintenance, Automation, Engineering, and external partners to achieve shared goals.    A proactive, structured, and safety-first approach, with a continuous improvement mindset.    Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken. Swedish is an advantage but not a requirement.Benefits at Stegra At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.Read more about Benefits at Stegra here.This is StegraStegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.Our Boden SiteOur Boden site is located just west of Boden City, right in the heart of a growing green industrial hub in Northern Sweden. It’s where we’re building one of the world’s most modern, sustainable steel plants—designed with safety, efficiency, and people in mind. With just a 10-minute commute from town, you'll be close to both cutting-edge technology and the everyday convenience of living near nature, schools, and community life.Boden Video

title: DCEO Engr 3
description: DescriptionAWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. We are currently seeking a Data Center Engineering Operations Technician to serve as a technical resource within our mission critical Data Center’s. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of Data Center Engineering Operations. We strive towards building a diverse workforce and look to hire the best people we can regardless of age, gender or ethnicity. Due to the success of the Amazon Web Services (AWS) operations and rapid expansion of Data Centers we are recruiting suitable candidates to operate/maintain these facilities in Sweden. In this role you will have a positive involvement in both the maintenance of facilities and the improvement of efficiencies to help offer Amazon customer’s better value. Key job responsibilities You will also be involved in: o Assisting in the operation and maintenance of all electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety equipment and HVAC equipment within the Data Center/Facility. This equipment supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. o Assisting in the maintenance and monitoring of all Data Center systems to include incidents/events, problems, changes, monitoring, problem escalation/notification/resolution and all other aspects of Data Center support. o Monitoring and troubleshooting all mechanical, electrical, HVAC systems, voice/data, cooling systems, fire/life safety equipment and generators. o Providing assistance to contractor or data center engineers to ensure proper operation and maintenance of all facility equipment. o Providing assistance to contractors or data center engineers to deploy new equipment, such as building racks, cabling, and other tasks as necessary. o Performing site walk throughs to verify proper operation of Facility Equipment and Monitoring Systems. In addition to acting as a Facilities First Responder to critical events, you will be a part of the team supporting new data center facilities and existing data center facilities!A day in the lifeDay to day activities for this role include; o Monitoring of all alarms and systems involved in the operation of power, cooling and fire suppression systems in the data center. o Planning and coordinating vendor works on site to ensure equipment is maintained and uptime retained. o Supporting other sites and teams during events and planned works. o Carrying out rack power up and installation duties. o Monitoring and facilitating new equipment handover. o Supporting new hires and team members through knowledge share and development. o Event response and drill participation. About the teamDiverse ExperiencesAWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS?Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.Inclusive Team CultureHere at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.Mentorship & Career GrowthWe’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life BalanceWe value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.Basic Qualifications- Electrical, mechanical or instrumentation training and/or relevant experience- 2+ years of relevant work experience- Strong English verbal and written communication skillsPreferred Qualifications- Experience in data center engineeringAmazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Backend Developer
description: MAJORITY is a groundbreaking all-in-one digital financial service app that includes an FDIC-insured account, Visa® Prepaid card, money remittance, and international calling. We are built for migrants, by migrants.Global migration is a 21st-century reality. Whether people are following their dreams, love or new experiences, more and more of us are leaning towards new environments. Our purpose at MAJORITY is to empower the amazing, the brave, and the talented and help them achieve all of their ambitions.We believe that everyone deserves the same opportunity to succeed. Our mission is to provide migrants the tools to thrive in their new country. We are a diverse group of people from over 40 different countries that come together every day and we're looking for others driven by the same desire to create meaningful products that bridge cultural and geographic distances.MAJORITY is looking for a skilled Senior Backend Developer to join our Backend team. This is a full time, hybrid position based at our office in Stockholm, Sweden. Developers may work from home up to 2 days a week.About our platform and MAJORITY    Our work matters to real people. It shows up in someone's paycheck or the money they send home    We build real-time money movement: card authorizations, risk decisions and balance updates that have to be fast and correct    Our backend is C# microservices on Kubernetes, connected through events where every message counts    Our engineers own what they build, from first design to production and beyond    We take on new challenges, not just new features, from new products to partner integrations    To secure high quality code we practice code review and pair programming, we use CI/CD and automated testing    We also have a lot of fun together. We have a lunch run club, play foosball and other games, go to the gym, AWs etcAbout you and your responsibilities    You take initiative and ownership, and don't wait to be told what to do    You are always curious and always learning    You take pride in the quality of your work.    You consider the whole system, cover the edge cases and test your codeYou are able to reason through the trade-offs and dare to make decisions for the benefit of the organization    You lead technical decisions and see them through    You think about the bigger picture: how services fit together and how the system will grow    You love to share your knowledge and learn from your colleaguesBasic Requirements    Experience building and running microservices and event-based systems in production, at scale    A track record of shipping real systems and supporting them in production    Solid understanding of distributed systems reliability: idempotency, retries, ordering and eventual consistency    Good understanding of higher level architecture and design    Excellent communication skills in EnglishIdeal candidate    Experience with C#, Kubernetes and SQL, or similar    Experience with payment platforms, FinTech, Banking or security    Experience working with a growing team on evolving products with many users    Experience building new products with an eye on maintainability and scalability    Vision for product development and for how a code base evolves    Uses AI tools like Claude or Codex in daily work    Happy hacking on new technology, loves R&D    A degree in computer science    A pleasure to work withIf you want to own systems that move real money for people building new lives, alongside a team that cares about getting it right, we'd love to hear from you. Apply by submitting your CV.We believe in equal opportunity and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Product Team Engineer - Hydraulic
description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description:Your mission Are you interested in and willing to learn and gain a broad technical knowledge about the product family / application and work in an “Product and customer” environment? title: Development Engineer – BONESUPPORT
description: Development Engineer – BONESUPPORTCome and join BONESUPPORT as Development Engineer! This is an opportunity to take an active role in the design and development of innovative medical devices, from early concepts to finalized products and manufacturing.BONESUPPORT is an innovative and growing medical device company based in Lund, Sweden. The company develops and commercializes injectable bio-ceramic bone graft substitutes for the treatment of bone disorders.To further strengthen our Development & Engineering department, we are now looking for a Development Engineer with a strong technical background and hands-on experience in mechanical design, product development and verification.Your roleAs Development Engineer, you will be involved in the development of new medical devices as well as improvements to existing products.You will work throughout the product development process, from concept development and mechanical design to verification, validation and transfer to manufacturing.The role has a strong technical focus, combining hands-on mechanical engineering and CAD design with testing, material selection and manufacturing considerations. You will be responsible for developing robust technical solutions that meet functional requirements and can be efficiently manufactured.You will work closely with colleagues within R&D, Operations, Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs, as well as external suppliers and manufacturing partners.Your main responsibilities will include:    Design and develop medical device components and assemblies using 3D CAD tools.    Execute design activities through all product development phases.    Create and maintain engineering drawings, technical specifications and design documentation.    Perform mechanical design activities, including material selection, tolerance analysis and component optimization.    Develop technical solutions with consideration for Design for Manufacturing (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA) and Design for Reliability.    Collaborate with suppliers and manufacturing partners on tooling, injection molding and manufacturing optimization.    Develop, plan and perform verification and validation testing.    Establish test methods and prepare test protocols and reports.    Analyze test results, identify potential improvements and provide recommendations for design modifications.    Participate in design reviews, risk management activities and cross-functional development projects.    Support design transfer activities and contribute to design control documentation in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.QualificationsWe are looking for a technically skilled engineer with practical experience in mechanical design and product development  within the medical device industry.To succeed in this role, we believe you have:    A technical academic background at Bachelor's level or higher, preferably in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.    Relevant experience in mechanical design and product development within the medical device industry.    Hands-on experience with 3D CAD software, such as SolidWorks, Inventor or similar.    Experience in creating engineering drawings, technical specifications and detailed design documentation.    Good understanding of materials, manufacturing processes and mechanical design principles.    Experience in planning, performing and documenting design verification activities, including test methods, protocols and reports for mechanical and functional testing.    Knowledge of Design for Manufacturing (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA) and tolerance analysis.    Ability to analyze technical problems, evaluate test results and develop practical engineering solutions.    Good technical writing and documentation skills.Preferred qualificationsIt is an advantage if you also have experience or knowledge in:    Injection molding, tooling and component manufacturing.    Design Control and requirements management.    Risk management according to ISO 14971.    Usability engineering according to IEC 62366.    Medical device safety standards.    Implantable medical devices.    Statistical methods and test method development.    Design transfer and collaboration with external manufacturing partners.Personal qualitiesWe believe you are analytical, structured and solution-oriented, with a strong interest in technical problem-solving and product development.You enjoy working hands-on with engineering challenges and have the ability to translate technical requirements into practical and reliable design solutions.You take ownership of your tasks, work independently and proactively drive activities forward. At the same time, you value collaboration and enjoy working with colleagues from different technical and functional backgrounds.You are comfortable working in an environment where technical challenges require both attention to detail and an understanding of the complete product development process.Why BONESUPPORT?At BONESUPPORT, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the development of innovative medical devices that make a difference for patients.You will join a growing company where product development, engineering and manufacturing expertise come together. The position offers an opportunity to take an active role in technical development projects and contribute to the continued development of BONESUPPORT's products.Location: Lund, SwedenApplicationSKÅNESTOR is managing the recruitment process on behalf of BONESUPPORT.Please apply directly through this advertisement. For questions, please contact SKÅNESTOR at maria.gren@skanestor.se.

title: OPEN application - Data Center Technician to a World Leading Tech Company
description: This advert is published due to recurring requests for candidates within this role. It helps us build a pipeline so we can act quickly when we receive a new assignment.When we get a relevant request from a client, we will review applications from this ad and contact candidates whose profile matches the specific requirements. This also means you may not hear from us in between, as there may be no active assignment at the time.Demand for this role can change quickly, and during the summer period it may not always be active.------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------On behalf of one of the world’s leading and most recognized tech companies, we are looking for two skilled Data Center Technician to their Data Center in Gävle Sweden. If you are looking for a unique career opportunity, that will provide you with many chances to learn, grow and further develop your skills within IT, Support, Hardware, Servers and more than this could be the right role for you.You will play a vital part in making the Data Centers daily operations run smoothly. description: ---base: /meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0--- Group Fitness Instructor (m/w/d)================================ Als Mitglied der internationalen **PureGym Gruppe** mit mehr als 2 Millionen Mitgliedern gehören wir zu den drei größten Fitnessketten in Europa und sind damit bestens aufgestellt, um unsere ehrgeizigen Ziele weiter zu verfolgen und zu realisieren. So können wir in Zukunft einen noch grösseren und wichtigeren Beitrag zur Fitness und Gesundheit der Schweizer Bevölkerung leisten.Für unser motiviertes Group Fitness Team in suchen wir ab sofort eine leidenschaftliche und sportbegeisterte Person als **Group Fitness Instructor (m/w/d) für unseren Club in Wohlen unter anderem für die folgenden Kurse:****LesMills BODYPUMP, M.A.X., RIDE, TONE , GRIT, ZUMBA, H.I.I.T., PILATES, BODYATTACK, BODYCOMBAT, YOGAFLOW/POWERYOGA, STEP.** **Start: ab sofort** **Dauer: unbefristet** **Standort: Wohlen****Deine Aufgaben:*** Du leitest die Group Fitness Kurse und vermittelst dein Fachwissen mit grosser Begeisterung.* Du bist für unsere Mitglieder da und betreust sie vor, während und nach deinen Kursen.* Du bereitest deine Kurse vor und hältst die Gruppendynamik aufrecht und motivierst deine Teilnehmer während des Kurses.* Du bist verantwortlich für die Einhaltung der Sauberkeit und Hygieneregeln im Kursraum.* Du kennst unsere Angebote und unsere Philosophie und kannst diese den Mitgliedern vermitteln.* Ggf. organisierst du selbstständig deine Stellvertretungen und bist auch bereit als Stellvertretung einzuspringen. **Dein Profil:*** Du hast bereits fundierte Erfahrung als Groupfitness Instructor für die aufgeführten Kursarten und kannst Group Fitness Diplome oder nachweisbare Diplome vorweisen* Du hast das Talent andere Menschen zu motivieren und sie mit jedem Training bei dir auf das nächste Level zu bringen* Du begeisterst unsere Mitglieder mit der Vielfalt deiner Trainingspalette und bringst in deinen Kursen sowohl Anfänger:innen als auch Fortgeschrittenen mit Spass an Bewegung zu ihren persönlichen Höchstleistungen* Du hast das Interesse und die Möglichkeit zukünftig mehrere Lektionen pro Woche an verschiedenen Wochentagen und/oder in verschiedenen Studios zu übernehmen* Du verfügst über gute DeutschkenntnisseAls Mitarbeiter von PureGym hast du Zutritt zu allen PureGym Clubs in der Schweiz. Ausserdem hast du die Möglichkeit ein Teil unseres wachsenden Groupfitness Angebots zu sein und dich mit Ideen und deiner Motivation einzubringen.**Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil der PureGym\-Familie**. Lass uns gemeinsam noch mehr Menschen die Möglichkeit geben, ein gesünderes Leben zu leben! ![PureGym AG]()* PureGym AG  9014 St. Gallen*

title: Bewirtschafter:in Stockwerkeigentum - für erfahrene Profis im Ruhestand
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Bewirtschafter:in Stockwerkeigentum - für erfahrene Profis im Ruhestand--- Bewirtschafter:in Stockwerkeigentum \- für erfahrene Profis im Ruhestand=========================================================================Pensioniert mit Mandat? Ihre Erfahrung im Stockwerkeigentum ist gefragt.------------------------------------------------------------------------ **Bewirtschafter/in Stockwerkeigentum – für erfahrene Profis im Ruhestand**Sie haben Eigentümergemeinschaften durch hitzige Versammlungen geführt, Sanierungen über die Ziellinie gebracht und Erneuerungsfonds aufgebaut, die heute noch tragen. Diese Erfahrung lässt sich in keinem Kurs lernen. Sie ist das Ergebnis jahrzehntelanger Praxis – und genau darauf setzen wir.Zusammen mit uns bleiben Sie am Ball – so viel und so oft, wie Sie möchten. Keine grossen Portfolios, kein Pflichtprogramm. Sondern einzelne Stockwerkeigentümergemeinschaften, die Sie mit Ihrer ganzen Erfahrung und in Ihrem Tempo begleiten.ANMAT ImmoTreuhand AG ist eine Boutique\-Immobilienbewirtschafterin mit Hauptsitz in Küssnacht am Rigi und einem Standort in Pfäffikon SZ – spezialisiert auf Stockwerkeigentum in der Innerschweiz. Im Generationenwechsel erneuern wir unsere digitale und prozessuale Basis mit Augenmass und entwickeln uns weiter – werden Sie ein Teil davon.### Ihr Wirkungsfeld* Sie betreuen einzelne, ausgewählte Stockwerkeigentümergemeinschaften im Kanton Schwyz. Wo Sie tätig werden, besprechen wir gemeinsam.* Sie bereiten Eigentümerversammlungen vor, leiten sie mit Ruhe und Souveränität und begleiten die Umsetzung von gefassten Beschlüssen.* Sie begleiten Unterhalt und Sanierungen, beraten zum Erneuerungsfonds und stehen den Verwaltungsausschüssen als kompetente Ansprechperson zur Seite.* Sie geben Ihr Know\-how an unsere junge Generation von Bewirtschafterinnen und Bewirtschaftern weiter – im gemeinsamen Mandat, an der Versammlung und im täglichen Austausch.* Sie bringen Ihre Sichtweise bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Abläufe und Arbeitsmittel ein. Denn Sie wissen aus Erfahrung, was sich in der Praxis bewährt.### Was Sie mitbringen* Langjährige Erfahrung in der Bewirtschaftung von Stockwerkeigentum* Sicherheit in Versammlungsführung, Reglementen und Stockwerkeigentumsrecht* Gelassenheit, wenn es emotional wird, und das Geschick, alle Beteiligten mitzunehmen* Freude daran, Wissen zu teilen und junge Kolleginnen und Kollegen in ihrer Entwicklung zu begleiten* Offenheit für neue Arbeitsweisen und digitale Hilfsmittel. Bei der Einarbeitung unterstützen wir Sie selbstverständlich.### Was wir bieten* **Freiheit in der Zeiteinteilung:** Sie gestalten Ihr Arbeitspensum flexibel und stimmen Ihre Einsätze auf Ihre persönlichen Bedürfnisse und auf die Anforderungen der Eigentümergemeinschaften ab.* **Unsere Infrastruktur, Ihr Rückhalt:**Arbeitssysteme, Vorlagen und ein Team im Hintergrund – Sie müssen nichts selbst aufbauen. Wir richten Ihnen alle Zugänge ein und begleiten Sie persönlich beim Einstieg.* **Homeoffice und Büro:** Sie arbeiten von zu Hause aus und sind bei Bedarf in unseren Büros jederzeit willkommen.* **Ferien ohne schlechtes Gewissen:** Ihre Stellvertretung ist im Team geregelt – auch wenn Sie einmal mehrere Wochen unterwegs sind.* **Ihre Erfahrung zählt:** Wir hören auf Sie. Ihre Ideen und Ihr Urteil fliessen in unsere Arbeit ein.* **Weitergeben, was bleibt:** Sie prägen die nächste Generation der Bewirtschaftung bei ANMAT und sorgen dafür, dass wertvolle Erfahrung und Praxiswissen erhalten bleiben.* **Teil von etwas Neuem:** Gestalten Sie mit, was aus ANMAT im Generationenwechsel wird.* **Faire Konditionen:** Teilzeitanstellung oder Mandat auf Stundenbasis – gut vereinbar als Nebenerwerb neben der Rente. Wir finden die Arbeitsform, die zu Ihrer Situation passt. Ihre Fahrspesen vergüten wir. **Klingt nach Ihnen?**Ein Lebenslauf genügt – oder rufen Sie uns einfach unter an. Ein erstes Gespräch ist bei uns persönlich, offen und unkompliziert. Gerne auch bei einem Kaffee.  **, CEO**  ANMAT ImmoTreuhand AG · Bahnhofstrasse 57 · 6403 Küssnacht am Rigi![ANMAT ImmoTreuhand AG]()* ANMAT ImmoTreuhand AG  Bahnhofstrasse 57  6403 Küssnacht am Rigi*jid2832c1ejm jit1044jm jiy26jm

title: Manager – SAP Tax Technology
description:
**Location:** Zurich

**Your contribution to KPMG**



* Lead tax transformation projects in SAP S/4HANA environments

* Six or more years of experience in tax technology, tax transformation, ERP consulting, or tax advisory

**Flexible Working**

With us, you'll find the support and flexibility you need to balance your career and private life. You can benefit from hybrid working models, flexible working hours, the option to work from abroad (up to 10 working days per calendar year), and generous parental leave. You also have the option to purchase additional vacation days.

Successful employees need top-tier IT infrastructure and excellent mobility-not only at work but also in their private lives. Our lunch allowance supports your daily meals, and you benefit from additional discounts across various areas.

To further support families, we offer places in holiday camps for children aged 6 to 15 during school holidays in cooperation with MS Sports. Additional support services are available through our Parents Circle.

**An inclusive culture**

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion is reflected in our policies and practices. Become part of a culture that celebrates individuality. In our various communities (KNOW, KNOW Young, Pride, and Internationals at KPMG), you can connect with like-minded colleagues.
[Values \& Culture](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/about/values-culture.html)

We are aware of the broader impact of our actions and provide trusted services with a consistent focus on ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance). In addition, we are actively committed to social responsibility by supporting volunteer work and promoting charitable projects through the KPMG Foundation.
[Commitment](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/about/commitment.html)



**Discover KPMG -- Become part of our team**

With 300 different auditing and advisory service opportunities, our people can choose the career path that suits them best. Through our competencies in business transformation as well as ESG consulting, we support our clients in today's biggest challenges. We are a purpose-led and values driven company where your insight can create opportunities for you and contribute to a better future. Vous organisez votre travail en grande autonomie, en lien étroit avec les équipes de gérance.1. **Avant\-projet** : vous visitez l'immeuble, effectuez des métrés rapides et estimez le coût des travaux sur la base de votre expérience, avec une précision de ± 25 %, sans demande d'offres,2. **Proposition au propriétaire** : en collaboration avec l'équipe de gérance de l'immeuble, vous présentez les subventions.Vous travaillez en binôme avec le responsable du département et vous appuyez sur les équipes de gérance (administration, technique, juridique). **Votre profil :*** CFC dans un métier du description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Conference &amp; Events Manager 100% (w/m/i)---Conference \& Events Manager 100% (w/m/i)=========================================ab Januar 2027 oder nach VereinbarungConference \& Events Manager 100% (w/m/i)=========================================ab Januar 2027 oder nach Vereinbarung   Eine Ikone der Schweizer Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873\. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.    Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.    Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz \- eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit erfüllt.    Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab Januar 2027 oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n:  Ihr umfangreiches Hauptaufgabengebiet umfasst unter anderem:* Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen, Erstellung von Angeboten und Verhandlung von Verträgen \- *sei es eine grosse Hochzeit, ein 2\-Personen Meeting, ein Buy\-out oder eine reine Gruppen\-Zimmerbuchung** Bewertung von RFPs in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Revenue Management* Kundenberatung, kreative Angebots\-/ Konzepterstellung (*inkl. Durchführung von Probeessen, Locationberatung \& Besichtigungen*)* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem proaktiven MICE und Team zur Steigerung der Lead\-Conversion* Erstellung detaillierter BEOs* Durchführung von BEO Meetings und Gewährleistung einer optimalen bereichsübergreifenden Kommunikation für einen reibungslosen Veranstaltungsablauf* Sicherstellung eines exzellenten Kundenservices vor, während und nach den Veranstaltungen* Gewährleistung eines reibungslosen Veranstaltungsablaufs in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Bankett Operations\- und den F\&B Teams, sowie alle involvierten operativen Abteilungen* Mitverantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung der unterstellten Mitarbeitenden sowie, sowie aktive Mitwirkung an internen AbteilungsschulungenSie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung sowie Erfahrung in der gehobenen und internationalen Hotellerie und haben bereits fundierte F\&B Kenntnisse sammeln können. Wir setzen sehr gutes know\-how mit MS Office\- und Hotelreservierungsprogrammen, Kommunikations\- und Verhandlungsgeschick sowie lösungsorientiertes Verhalten, eine selbständige Arbeitsweise und Detailgenauigkeit voraus. Verantwortungs\- und Organisationsbewusstsein genau wie ein sicheres, freundliches Auftreten, Freude am Umgang mit Menschen und sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch zeichnen Sie aus. Wenn Sie bereits mit OPERA gearbeitet haben, ist dies ein grosses Plus. Sie denken und handeln vernetzt, sind kundenorientiert und erkennen Prioritäten von sich aus.    Neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz profitieren Sie von zahlreichen attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und Vergünstigungen. Das Personalhaus verfügt über ein eigenes Fitnessstudio, eine TV\-Lounge, einen Billardraum sowie eine Bibliothek. Darüber hinaus geniessen Sie Ermässigungen in unseren Restaurants sowie Vorzugskonditionen für Sie, Ihre Familie und Freunde für Übernachtungen in unseren Hotels. Weitere Vorteile umfassen Vergünstigungen für Tennis, Golf, Sportartikel, Versicherungen, Gruppenkurse und REKA\-Checks.    Auch Ihre Mobilität unterstützen wir: Die Anreise mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln wird finanziell gefördert, und Parkplätze stehen zu attraktiven Konditionen zur Verfügung.    Wir investieren in Ihre Zukunft: Mit Zugang zur Beekeeper\-Mitarbeiterapp, vielfältigen Weiterbildungsangeboten, internen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und erstklassigen Karriereperspektiven schaffen wir den Rahmen für Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entfaltung.    Sie erwartet die Chance, Teil eines Weltklasse\-Resorts zu sein, aktiv zum gemeinsamen Erfolg beizutragen und sich in einem inspirierenden Umfeld kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.    Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Motivationsschreiben, Arbeitszeugnissen und Foto.     Auszeichnungen:   *Swiss Location Awards «Switzerland's Best Meeting Location»  World Spa Awards «Switzerland's Best Hotel Spa 2025»  LHW Membership Awards «Sustainability Leader»  Great Place To Work 2025  The New York Times'«52 Places to Go in 2018»  Travel \+ Leisure«500 List 2021»  Handelszeitung«Bester Arbeitgeber im Hospitality Sektor 2023»  Connoisseur Circle «Best Gourmet Hotel»  MICHELIN Wellness Award «Best Wellness Hotel»  GALA Spa Awards «Best Spa Concept»  MICHELIN Keys «3/3 Keys»     *BÜRGENSTOCK HOTELS AG  Würzer  HR Business Partner \& Talents  Bürgenstock 30  6363 Obbürgen  Telefon**        ******jid7cdc3e3jm jit1044jm jiy26jm

title: Health AI Product Owner
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Health AI Product Owner (m/w/d)--- Health AI Product Owner (m/w/d)===============================**Health AI Product Owner (m/w/d)**  As Product Owner you run day to day. You are the link between medical expertise and software development: you translate biomarker logic, supplement science and customer needs into clear requirements and work packages, and you make sure what is delivered is correct, safe and useful. You work closely with the Medical Lead, the Strategic Lead and an external development team. **Workload:** 60%**Location:** Zug, Purpur Hub (hybrid possible) \- residence in Switzerland**Start date:** Immediately / by agreement**Reports to:** Strategic Lead is the personal health companion of Tortuga Sense. It turns blood values, personal goals and lifestyle information into a personalized, reasoned supplement recommendation and explains it in plain language. Recommendations are derived from a medically governed rule set; a language model explains them, backed by a curated knowledge base. The product supports prevention and wellbeing. It does not diagnose or treat. The first version is built from October 2026 to January 2027, piloted with 50–100 customers and partners from February to March 2027, and launched in 2027\. **What awaits you*** A key role in building a new health product. From the first version to market launch.* Real product ownership, short decision paths and direct exchange with medical experts, leadership and the development team.* A dynamic start\-up environment at the Purpur Hub in Zug with room for your own ideas.* A flexible, hybrid working model. **Your responsibilities*** Own the product backlog: define features, user stories and acceptance criteria and prioritise them against the agreed scope* Translate the medical rule set (biomarkers, thresholds, supplement and dosage logic) into precise, testable specifications together with the Medical Lead* Design the customer journey with the team: questionnaire and consents, lab report upload, recommendation, report dialogue and history* Help maintain the knowledge base and select, check and reference scientific sources. Review the explanations generated by the language model for scientific accuracy, clarity and compliance (no diagnosis, no therapy recommendation)* Steer sprints with the development partner, perform functional acceptance of all deliveries and coordinate medical sign\-off before release* Plan and run internal testing on real cases and the closed pilot with customers and external partners (e.g. medical practices, pharmacies)* Make sure requirements reflect regulatory boundaries (non\-medical\-device positioning, health claims) and data\-protection needs (consents, sensitive health data)* Monitor the budget against agreed funding, and flag deviations early **What you bring*** Background in life sciences, nutrition science, pharmacy, biomedicine, medicine or comparable practical experience in a health or supplement setting* Solid knowledge in at least one of: dietary supplements and micronutrients, prevention/longevity or laboratory diagnostics. You can read a blood panel and understand biomarkers and reference ranges, or clearly bring the readiness to get up to speed here quickly with the Medical Lead* Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager or in a comparable role, ideally in digital health, health tech or diagnostics* You write clear requirements and user stories and work with developers in an agile setting* A structured, hands\-on way of working; you take decisions and hold scope* Very good English, written and spoken \- English is our working language across the team. is a strong advantage, in particular for the Swiss market and partners **Nice to have*** Experience with lab data, LIS/lab report formats or health data standards (e.g. LOINC, HL7/FHIR)* Experience with AI\-based products, rule engines or clinical decision logic* Knowledge of the regulatory framework for supplements, health claims and medical device software in Switzerland and the EU (e.g. MDR, revFADP/GDPR)* Experience running pilots with health professionals, pharmacies or consumers **What we offer you*** Plenty of personal responsibility and real product ownership in a young, dynamic environment* Direct collaboration with medical experts, leadership and an experienced development team* Short decision paths and room to shape the product* Working at the Purpur Hub in Zug at Grienbachstrasse 17* Market\-standard employment conditions, flexible working hours and the possibility of home office* A collegial working atmosphere on equal footing – your four\-legged friend is warmly welcome in the office **Sound like you?**Then we look forward to your application with your CV and a few lines on your experience with supplements, prevention or diagnostics and with product ownership. For further questions, feel free to reach out directly to us.![Purpur Ventures AG]()* Purpur Ventures AG  Grienbachstrasse 17  6300 Zug*jidb76c79bjm jit1044jm jiy26jm

Nos filiales complètent cette offre grâce à leurs services d'expertise immobilière, de réalisation et de suivi de projets architecturaux. Intégrez aujourd'hui une équipe accueillante, humaine et créative ! Pour notre agence de \*\*Neuchâtel\*\* nous sommes à la recherche d'un\\-e : ### Conducteur\\-trice de travaux \\- \*Service rénovations énergétiques\* \*\*Vos missions\*\* Vous accompagnez les propriétaires d'immeubles dans leurs projets de rénovation et d'assainissement énergétique de leur patrimoine. Pour cela, vous assurez la conduite technique, administrative et financière des travaux de rénovation d'immeubles d'habitation, tout en garantissant la conformité avec les normes en vigueur, le respect des délais, du budget et de la sécurité. Vous organisez votre travail en grande autonomie, en lien étroit avec les équipes de gérance. 1. \*\*Avant\\-projet\*\* : vous visitez l'immeuble, effectuez des métrés rapides et estimez le coût des travaux sur la base de votre expérience, avec une précision de ± 25 %, sans demande d'offres, 2. \*\*Proposition au propriétaire\*\* : en collaboration avec l'équipe de gérance de l'immeuble, vous présentez les travaux recommandés, le budget et le planning, et obtenez sa validation, 3. \*\*Coordination des spécialistes\*\* : lorsque le projet l'exige, vous mandatez et coordonnez architecte (dépôt de plans), ingénieur civil, ingénieur CVSE ou thermicien, 4. \*\*Appels d'offres et adjudications\*\* : vous consultez les entreprises, comparez les offres, négociez et adjugez les travaux, 5. \*\*Financement et subventions\*\* : vous constituez les dossiers de crédit de construction pour les banques et les demandes de subventions, 6. \*\*Suivi de chantier\*\* : vous tenez le planning, assurez des visites régulières, coordonnez les entreprises et, avec l'équipe de gérance, assurez l'information des locataires, 7. \*\*Gestion financière\*\* : vous contrôlez les situations et factures, ordonnez les paiements et suivez le budget, en coordination avec le ou la responsable de portefeuille, en charge de la gestion de l'immeuble, 8. \*\*Clôture\*\* : vous établissez le décompte final et finalisez les subventions. Vous travaillez en binôme avec le responsable du département et vous appuyez sur les équipes de gérance (administration, technique, juridique). \*\*Votre profil :\*\* \* CFC dans un métier du bâtiment Monteur sanitaire expérimenté
===============================

 

### Introduction

 

Gomatech CVC Sàrl recherche un(e) **Monteur sanitaire expérimenté** pour renforcer son équipe en Suisse. Vous intervenez sur des installations sanitaires variées, aussi bien dans le cadre de nouvelles constructions que de rénovations, avec un souci constant de qualité, de précision et de sécurité.

 

### Responsabilités

 

* Réaliser des installations sanitaires dans des bâtiments résidentiels, commerciaux et industriels
* Lire et interpréter les plans, schémas et dossiers techniques
* Installer, raccorder et mettre en service les conduites, appareils et équipements sanitaires
* Effectuer des travaux de dépannage, de maintenance et de rénovation
* Contrôler l’étanchéité et le bon fonctionnement des installations
* Respecter les normes suisses, les prescriptions de sécurité et les exigences de qualité
* Collaborer avec les autres corps de métier présents sur les chantiers
* Assurer un travail propre, autonome et organisé


 

### Qualifications

 

* Formation professionnelle dans le domaine sanitaire ou titre jugé équivalent
* Expérience confirmée en tant que monteur sanitaire en Suisse
* Bonne maîtrise de la lecture de plans et des techniques d’installation sanitaire
* Autonomie, rigueur et sens des responsabilités
* Esprit d’équipe et bonne capacité de communication
* Permis de conduire, un atout
* Connaissance des normes et pratiques suisses, souhaitée
* Bonne condition physique et aptitude à travailler sur différents types de chantiers


 

### Benefits

 

* Un poste stable au sein d’une entreprise active dans le secteur CVC
* Des projets variés et techniquement intéressants
* Un environnement de travail professionnel et respectueux
* Une équipe dynamique et orientée vers la qualité
* Des possibilités de perfectionnement et d’évolution
* Des conditions de travail conformes aux usages du marché suisse
* Un véhicule
* Tout le matériel nécéssaire


 

### Application information

 

Si ce poste correspond à votre profil et à vos aspirations professionnelles, nous vous invitons à consulter les modalités de candidature prévues par Gomatech CVC Sàrl et à nous faire parvenir les informations demandées. Nous nous réjouissons de faire votre connaissance.

title: Quantitative LNG Analyst
description: The position is based on the Geneva trading floor, with regular contact with Houston, Singapore and Paris based teams.JOB DIMENSIONS The Modelling and Analysis for Trading Strategies team aims at providing a better understanding of the markets traded by TotalEnergies Gas and Power (TGP) in terms of prices and fundamentals, finding ways to model and forecast their dynamics and dealing with complex issues requiring a quantitative approach.  The Gas/LNG/Dry Modelling and Analysis team is formed of market fundamentals experts and quantitative researchers. In a context of great autonomy, the team contributes with interpretation of market, advisory and support to all TGP trading desks and to senior management - including COMEX members - and helps them define trading strategies and take investment decisions. The job holder influences the global TGP trading performance and works with trading desks and other stakeholders throughout the organization to identify opportunities for leveraging data in order to help traders take positions on the market and more broadly the Company to catch new business opportunities. This requires in-depth analysis of complex and unique problems as well as creative and strategic thinking.The holder of the position will work on the Global Gas balance, with particular focus and responsibility on maintaining existing analytical tools and create new ones. Excellent coding capabilities and quantitative mindset are required.  ACTIVITIESYou will be at the forefront of development of scalable, reusable, and intelligent frameworks that contribute to long-term P&L growth, ensuring they are built as maintainable, long-living, production-grade solutions. You will build extensible frameworks that evolve with business needs and are used across Gas&LNG trading desks. You will iteratively enhance these frameworks to support rapid feature delivery while minimizing technical debt and ensuring long-term maintainability. You will provide support to users (data scientists from MATS teams and traders) by leveraging your solid understanding of the tools developed in the team. You will facilitate their work by clearly presenting the features and guiding them to fully utilize the capabilities of the frameworks, ensuring they can maximize their potential. You will collaborate with key partner teams (e.g. Algo Strategies, Modelling & Analysis) to co-develop specialized tools, ensuring flexibility for researchers while maintaining core architectural standards. You will work on a variety of different problems related to energy and commodity markets and acquire business knowledge.  CONTEXT AND ENVIRONMENTTotalEnergies Gas and Power is the trading arm of TotalEnergies in the field of low carbon energies (mainly gas, LNG and power). As such it operates in fast-evolving market dynamics influenced by internal and external factors that require constant adaptation and evolution. Uncertainties specific to the trading environment (volatility of prices, supply & demand mismatches) are coupled with those coming from the broader energy sector (climate change policies, changes in the energy mix, developments of new energy sources, etc). In such context Trading helps to ensure growth and profitability to a key segment of the business in order to reach the objective of Carbon Neutrality by 2050.ACCOUNTABILITIESTest and integrate advanced techniques and quantitative algorithms, with a focus on continuous improvement.  Participate in the definition of the forward view of the iGas desksHelp build and communicate a global view of energy markets, enhance the Company’s understanding of energy markets interactionsContribute to the management of the relationship with the related Total entities and clients of the Research team.QUALIFICATIONS/EXPERIENCE REQUIREDStrong technical or engineering background with a MSc in Comp. Science, Mathematics, Physics or EngineeringAt least 2 years experience on similar roles covering LNG and/or Natural Gas in a trading environment.A curious individual with a strong team spirit, always seeking to improve and innovate beyond the status quo. Strong ability to adapt to continuously changing environment.Programming skills (Python,SQL,), as well as familiarity with Optimization frameworks and statistical methods;Fluent in English (oral and written) – knowledge of French and/or other languages is an advantage;The position requires autonomy, objectivity, innovation, to be resourceful and well organisedThe ideal candidate should be able to explain complex issues and present them in a clear and concise manner. He/she should demonstrate openness when their ideas are challenged, and bring a proactive approach.

improvement initiatives to enhance the efficiency, consistency, scalability and control effectiveness of client lifecycle processes. \* Identify and implement opportunities for automation, digitalisation and the use of data analytics, workflow solutions and AI to streamline operations and improve decision\\-making. \* Contribute to the development and maintenance of internal procedures, guidelines and operational standards, ensuring alignment with evolving regulatory and business requirements. \* Act as a trusted point of contact to front\\-line teams, offering clear and pragmatic guidance. \* Collaborate with key stakeholders, provide pragmatic guidance on complex matters, and represent HNWI CLI in cross\\-functional initiatives and strategic projects. Team Management: \* \*\*Leading and supporting the team:\*\* + Fostering a positive work atmosphere where employees feel motivated, valued, and connected to the team and the organization; + Promoting collaboration, trust, and cohesion among team members; + Addressing any potential conflicts among team members to your senior management and/or HR Partner; + Supporting employee growth through training, mentorship, coaching, and advancement opportunities. \* \*\*Hiring:\*\* + Leading the recruitment process with your Talent Acquisition Partner; practical experience with automation or AI\\-enabled solutions is an asset. \* Important analytical and problem\\-solving capabilities, with a structured, proactive and solution\\-oriented approach. \* Strong leadership potential, with a genuine interest in developing people, fostering collaboration and driving accountability. \* Ability to manage operational priorities, maintain high\\-quality standards and make sound, risk\\-based decisions in a demanding environment. \* Robust communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage constructively with both operational teams and senior management. \* Excellent command of English and French; title: Senior Manager, GVP Compliance
description: About the role- Strengthen key elements of the global Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) compliance framework by executing and maintaining a risk‑based, digitally enabled quality system that is compliant, scalable, and sustainable across Takeda’s pharmacovigilance system.- Contribute to the implementation of an integrated GVP compliance approach in close partnership with the PSPV function and the Center for Continuous Improvement for CTD and PV, supporting aligned quality oversight and effective adoption of regulatory intelligence.- Support the effectiveness of GVP investigations, audits, and inspections by applying robust root‑cause analysis, supporting CAPA execution and compliance monitoring, and contributing to global GVP inspection readiness activities.- Contribute to effective GVP quality governance by supporting monitoring and reporting of GVP compliance risks, trends, and mitigation actions through PSPV governance forums, the R&D Quality risk register, and the Clinical & Safety Quality Council.How you will contribute- Manage and support the operation of the GVP Quality Management System (QMS) by executing review, implementation, and maintenance of standards, policies, and procedures supporting GVP‑regulated activities within PSPV.- Execute core GVP quality system processes including change control, deviations and investigations, incident notification and escalation, and CAPA management, acting as a GVP compliance subject‑matter expert.- Support investigations of significant GVP quality events and deviations, applying root‑cause analysis methodologies to support effective remediation and prevention of recurrence.- Support CAPA lifecycle management, including tracking implementation and effectiveness, monitoring timely completion of actions related to quality events, audits, and inspections, and escalating risks where appropriate.- Support GVP inspection readiness activities, including preparation, coordination, document sup-port, and execution of inspection activities using established processes and available technologies.- Support assigned GVP regulatory inspections, including inspection preparation, hosting support, response development, tracking of commitments, risk escalation, and mitigation activities in collaboration with cross‑functional stakeholders.- Support strategic quality oversight of PV suppliers, including review of Quality Agreements, participation in supplier governance activities, and escalation of identified compliance risks in partner-ship with PSPV.- Provide GVP compliance review and quality input to Pharmacovigilance Agreements (PVAs), ensuring alignment with applicable global GVP regulations and Takeda standards, and escalating identified gaps, risks, or ambiguities to senior GVP Compliance leadership as appropriate.- Contribute GVP quality and compliance data to the Pharmacovigilance System Master File (PSMF), supporting the accurate reflection of Takeda’s pharmacovigilance system, processes, governance, and oversight framework.- Ensure consistency between PSPV quality system documentation, PVAs, and the PSMF, identifying inconsistencies or emerging risks and supporting corrective actions to maintain regulatory alignment and inspection readiness.- Support responses to regulatory authority requests related to the PSMF and PVAs, including preparation of supporting documentation and evidence in collaboration with PSPV, R&D Quality, and Global Regulatory stakeholders.- Contribute to quality governance activities, including preparation of materials and inputs for Management Review and the Clinical & Safety Quality Council related to GVP compliance.- Provide support for Global Quality internal audits and Business Alliance audits across Takeda’s pharmacovigilance system, including preparation, coordination, response support, and CAPA follow‑up.Skills and qualifications- Scientific or allied health qualification (BSc required; Master’s/PhD strongly preferred).- Experience (5+ years) in the global pharmaceutical industry in PV and Quality and Compliance roles (3+ years).- Strong working knowledge and understanding of pharmacovigilance regulations including ICH Pharmacovigilance Guidelines (E2 Series), EMA Good Pharmacovigilance Practices (GVP) Directives and Modules,  US Code of Federal Regulations (CFR), FAERS and Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategies (REMS), Japan PMDA & MHLW GVP Ordinance and Good Post‑Marketing Study Practice (GPSP) Ordinance, Health Canada, World Health Organization (WHO) global multinational framework for International Drug Monitoring and those in countries such as China (NMPA PV), India (PvPI), etc.- Experience in supporting GVP audits and regulatory inspections, investigations and remediation.- Strong attention to detail with a quality and compliance mindset.- Ability to operate effectively in cross‑functional, matrixed environments.- Solid analytical and problem‑solving skills.- Clear written and verbal communication skills.- Ability to manage priorities and execute under timelines.- Professional judgment with willingness to escalate risks
